definition: the complete range of skills, techniques, or materials used in a particular field or activity
example_sentence: The researcher expanded her methodological repertoire to include qualitative analysis.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacı metodolojik repertuvarını nitel analizi de içerecek şekilde genişletti.
collocations: expand repertoire; methodological repertoire; skill repertoire; linguistic repertoire

definition: to acquire or secure something through effort or request
example_sentence: Researchers must obtain ethical approval before conducting human studies.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar insan çalışmaları yapmadan önce etik onay almalıdır.
collocations: obtain permission; obtain data; obtain results; obtain funding

definition: the way something is spread out or arranged over an area, time, or among a group
example_sentence: The normal distribution is fundamental to statistical analysis.
turkish_translation: Normal dağılım istatistiksel analiz için temeldir.
collocations: normal distribution; data distribution; income distribution; frequency distribution

definition: a numerical or measurable factor that defines the characteristics of a system
example_sentence: The study adjusted multiple parameters to optimize the experimental conditions.
turkish_translation: Çalışma deney koşullarını optimize etmek için birden fazla parametreyi ayarladı.
collocations: set parameters; statistical parameter; key parameter; experimental parameter

definition: a particular part, feature, or characteristic of something
example_sentence: The study examined various aspects of language acquisition in children.
turkish_translation: Çalışma çocuklarda dil ediniminin çeşitli yönlerini inceledi.
collocations: important aspect; key aspect; different aspect; particular aspect

definition: characterized by constant change, activity, or progress
example_sentence: The dynamic nature of technology requires continuous learning.
turkish_translation: Teknolojinin dinamik doğası sürekli öğrenme gerektirir.
collocations: dynamic process; dynamic system; dynamic change; dynamic interaction

definition: a strong effect or influence on someone or something
example_sentence: The pandemic had a significant impact on educational practices worldwide.
turkish_translation: Pandemi dünya çapında eğitim uygulamaları üzerinde önemli bir etkiye sahipti.
collocations: significant impact; positive impact; environmental impact; measure impact

definition: a specific area of activity, knowledge, or influence
example_sentence: Artificial intelligence applications span multiple domains of science.
turkish_translation: Yapay zeka uygulamaları bilimin birden fazla alanına yayılır.
collocations: academic domain; research domain; public domain; specific domain

definition: to prepare and issue material for public distribution or sale
example_sentence: The team plans to publish their findings in a peer-reviewed journal.
turkish_translation: Takım bulgularını hakemli bir dergide yayınlamayı planlıyor.
collocations: publish research; publish findings; publish online; publish results

definition: to be a sign of or to indicate something clearly
example_sentence: In mathematics, the symbol π denotes the ratio of circumference to diameter.
turkish_translation: Matematikte π sembolü çevre ile çapın oranını belirtir.
collocations: denote meaning; clearly denote; denote relationship; symbols denote

definition: the power or right to give orders, make decisions, and enforce obedience in a particular sphere
example_sentence: The research ethics committee has the authority to approve or reject experimental protocols.
turkish_translation: Araştırma etiği komitesi deneysel protokolleri onaylama veya reddetme yetkisine sahiptir.
collocations: regulatory authority; academic authority; legal authority; public authority

definition: relating to meaning in language or logic
example_sentence: The semantic analysis revealed subtle differences in word usage across cultural contexts.
turkish_translation: Anlamsal analiz, kültürel bağlamlarda kelime kullanımındaki ince farkları ortaya çıkardı.
collocations: semantic field; semantic meaning; semantic analysis; semantic memory

definition: an accepted standard or normal level
example_sentence: The student's performance was below par compared to international benchmarks.
turkish_translation: Öğrencinin performansı uluslararası standartlara kıyasla ortalamanın altındaydı.
collocations: on par with; below par; above par; at par

definition: an atom or molecule with a net electric charge due to loss or gain of electrons
example_sentence: The concentration of calcium ions in the solution affects cellular membrane permeability.
turkish_translation: Çözeltideki kalsiyum iyon konsantrasyonu hücresel membran geçirgenliğini etkiler.
collocations: positive ion; negative ion; ion concentration; ion exchange

definition: a rectangular array of numbers or mathematical objects arranged in rows and columns
example_sentence: The correlation matrix displayed the relationships between all measured variables.
turkish_translation: Korelasyon matrisi, ölçülen tüm değişkenler arasındaki ilişkileri gösterdi.
collocations: correlation matrix; data matrix; matrix multiplication; identity matrix

definition: arranged in or extending along a straight line; involving one dimension only
example_sentence: The linear regression model showed a strong positive relationship between study time and test scores.
turkish_translation: Doğrusal regresyon modeli, çalışma süresi ile test skorları arasında güçlü pozitif bir ilişki gösterdi.
collocations: linear regression; linear relationship; linear equation; linear programming

definition: relating to cognition or mental processes of perception, memory, judgment, and reasoning
example_sentence: Cognitive load theory suggests that effective instruction should minimize extraneous mental processing.
turkish_translation: Bilişsel yük teorisi, etkili öğretimin zihinsel işlemleri en aza indirmesi gerektiğini önerir.
collocations: cognitive psychology; cognitive load; cognitive development; cognitive abilities

definition: a diagram showing the relation between variable quantities, typically measured along two axes
example_sentence: The scatter graph revealed an unexpected inverse correlation between the two variables.
turkish_translation: Dağılım grafiği, iki değişken arasında beklenmedik bir ters korelasyon ortaya koydu.
collocations: bar graph; line graph; scatter graph; graph theory

definition: a mutual relationship or connection between two or more things
example_sentence: The study found a significant correlation between socioeconomic status and academic achievement.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, sosyoekonomik durum ile akademik başarı arasında anlamlı bir korelasyon buldu.
collocations: positive correlation; negative correlation; correlation coefficient; statistical correlation

definition: relating to language or the study of language
example_sentence: The linguistic diversity of the region presents both challenges and opportunities for education policy.
turkish_translation: Bölgenin dilsel çeşitliliği eğitim politikası için hem zorluklar hem de fırsatlar sunmaktadır.
collocations: linguistic analysis; linguistic competence; linguistic diversity; linguistic theory

definition: a chemical compound that typically has a sour taste and can neutralize alkalis
example_sentence: The acid concentration in the solution was measured using a pH meter to ensure experimental accuracy.
turkish_translation: Deneysel doğruluğu sağlamak için çözeltideki asit konsantrasyonu pH metre ile ölçüldü.
collocations: amino acid; fatty acid; acid rain; acid test

definition: to bring about or give rise to; to cause something to happen
example_sentence: The experimental treatment was designed to induce behavioral changes in the control group.
turkish_translation: Deneysel tedavi kontrol grubunda davranışsal değişiklikleri oluşturmak için tasarlandı.
collocations: induce change; induce response; induce labor; induce stress

definition: the speed of something in a given direction; the rate of change of position
example_sentence: The particle's velocity was calculated using the displacement data collected over time intervals.
turkish_translation: Parçacığın hızı, zaman aralıklarında toplanan yer değiştirme verileri kullanılarak hesaplandı.
collocations: angular velocity; escape velocity; terminal velocity; velocity vector

definition: a space of time between events or a pause between periods of activity
example_sentence: Data collection occurred at regular intervals throughout the longitudinal study period.
turkish_translation: Veri toplama, uzunlamasına çalışma dönemi boyunca düzenli aralıklarla gerçekleşti.
collocations: time interval; confidence interval; regular intervals; interval scale

definition: written or spoken communication or debate; a formal discussion of a topic
example_sentence: The academic discourse surrounding climate change has evolved significantly over the past decade.
turkish_translation: İklim değişikliği çevresindeki akademik söylem son on yılda önemli ölçüde gelişti.
collocations: academic discourse; public discourse; discourse analysis; political discourse

definition: having limits or bounds; not infinite
example_sentence: The researcher worked with a finite sample size, which limited the generalizability of the findings.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacı sınırlı bir örneklem büyüklüğüyle çalıştı, bu da bulguların genellenebilirliğini sınırladı.
collocations: finite resources; finite element; finite set; finite state

definition: something that rouses activity or energy in someone or something; a thing that evokes a response
example_sentence: The visual stimulus was presented for exactly 200 milliseconds to control for reaction time variables.
turkish_translation: Görsel uyaran, reaksiyon zamanı değişkenlerini kontrol etmek için tam olarak 200 milisaniye süreyle sunuldu.
collocations: external stimulus; stimulus response; economic stimulus; sensory stimulus

definition: a quantity having direction as well as magnitude; a carrier of disease or genetic material
example_sentence: The force vector was decomposed into horizontal and vertical components for analysis.
turkish_translation: Kuvvet vektörü, analiz için yatay ve dikey bileşenlere ayrıştırıldı.
collocations: position vector; velocity vector; unit vector; vector space

definition: a stable subatomic particle with a negative electric charge
example_sentence: The electron microscopy revealed structural details at the nanoscale level.
turkish_translation: Elektron mikroskopisi nanometre ölçeğinde yapısal detayları ortaya çıkardı.
collocations: electron microscope; electron beam; electron density; free electron

definition: an organ or cell able to respond to light, heat, or other external stimulus
example_sentence: The study examined how neurotransmitters bind to specific receptor sites in the brain.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, nörotransmitterlerin beyindeki belirli reseptör bölgelerine nasıl bağlandığını inceledi.
collocations: sensory receptor; hormone receptor; receptor binding; receptor site

definition: a general proposition proven by a chain of reasoning; a mathematical statement that has been proven
example_sentence: The Pythagorean theorem demonstrates the fundamental relationship between the sides of a right triangle.
turkish_translation: Pisagor teoremi, dik üçgenin kenarları arasındaki temel ilişkiyi gösterir.
collocations: mathematical theorem; prove a theorem; fundamental theorem; theorem proof

definition: a process or set of rules to be followed in calculations or problem-solving operations
example_sentence: The machine learning algorithm successfully classified 95% of the test data accurately.
turkish_translation: Makine öğrenmesi algoritması test verilerinin %95'ini başarıyla doğru sınıflandırdı.
collocations: sorting algorithm; search algorithm; optimization algorithm; algorithm design

definition: a substance that has no fixed shape and yields easily to external pressure; a liquid or gas
example_sentence: The fluid dynamics experiment analyzed how viscosity affects flow patterns in narrow channels.
turkish_translation: Akışkanlar dinamiği deneyi, viskoziterin dar kanallardaki akış desenlerini nasıl etkilediğini analiz etti.
collocations: fluid mechanics; fluid dynamics; body fluid; fluid flow

definition: relating to the growth and development of something over time
example_sentence: The developmental psychology course examined cognitive changes from infancy through adolescence.
turkish_translation: Gelişim psikolojisi dersi, bebeklikten ergenliğe kadar bilişsel değişiklikleri inceledi.
collocations: developmental psychology; developmental stage; developmental disorder; developmental milestone

definition: having a boundary or limit; confined within certain limits
example_sentence: The research parameters were bound by ethical guidelines and budget constraints.
turkish_translation: Araştırma parametreleri etik kurallar ve bütçe kısıtlamaları ile sınırlandırıldı.
collocations: upper bound; lower bound; bound variable; boundary condition

definition: relating to or consisting of molecules; occurring at the molecular level
example_sentence: The molecular structure of the compound was determined using X-ray crystallography techniques.
turkish_translation: Bileşiğin moleküler yapısı X-ışını kristalografisi teknikleri kullanılarak belirlendi.
collocations: molecular biology; molecular structure; molecular weight; molecular formula

definition: a thorough or dramatic change in form or appearance; a metamorphosis
example_sentence: The digital transformation of education has accelerated significantly since the pandemic.
turkish_translation: Eğitimin dijital dönüşümü pandemi sonrasında önemli ölçüde hızlandı.
collocations: digital transformation; social transformation; transformation process; energy transformation

definition: relating to space and the position, area, and size of things
example_sentence: The spatial analysis revealed significant clustering patterns in the demographic data.
turkish_translation: Mekansal analiz, demografik verilerde önemli kümelenme kalıpları ortaya çıkardı.
collocations: spatial analysis; spatial distribution; spatial reasoning; spatial awareness

definition: a numerical or constant quantity placed before and multiplying a variable in an algebraic expression
example_sentence: The correlation coefficient indicated a strong positive relationship between the two variables.
turkish_translation: Korelasyon katsayısı, iki değişken arasında güçlü pozitif bir ilişki olduğunu gösterdi.
collocations: correlation coefficient; regression coefficient; expansion coefficient; coefficient of determination

definition: the process of translating words or text from one language into another
example_sentence: The translation of the research findings into multiple languages facilitated international collaboration.
turkish_translation: Araştırma bulgularının birden fazla dile çevrilmesi uluslararası işbirliğini kolaylaştırdı.
collocations: machine translation; literal translation; translation studies; translation error

definition: a thin layer that covers or lines something, especially in living organisms
example_sentence: The cell membrane regulates the passage of substances into and out of the cell.
turkish_translation: Hücre zarı, maddelerin hücreye girip çıkmasını düzenler.
collocations: cell membrane; membrane permeability; membrane protein; semipermeable membrane

definition: a specialized cell transmitting nerve impulses in the nervous system
example_sentence: The study examined how neurons communicate through synaptic transmission.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, nöronların sinaptik iletim yoluyla nasıl iletişim kurduğunu inceledi.
collocations: motor neuron; sensory neuron; neuron network; neuron activation

definition: imitation of a situation or process using a computer model
example_sentence: The climate simulation predicted temperature changes over the next century.
turkish_translation: İklim simülasyonu gelecek yüzyıl boyunca sıcaklık değişikliklerini öngördü.
collocations: computer simulation; simulation model; flight simulation; simulation software

definition: relating to the words or vocabulary of a language
example_sentence: The lexical analysis identified patterns in word frequency across different text genres.
turkish_translation: Sözcüksel analiz, farklı metin türlerinde kelime sıklığı kalıplarını belirledi.
collocations: lexical analysis; lexical meaning; lexical item; lexical diversity

definition: a system or ordered way of managing something; a set of rules or procedures
example_sentence: The new treatment regime showed promising results in clinical trials.
turkish_translation: Yeni tedavi rejimi klinik denemelerde umut veren sonuçlar gösterdi.
collocations: treatment regime; exercise regime; dietary regime; regulatory regime

definition: the quality or state of being different or inconsistent; a statistical measure of spread
example_sentence: The variance in test scores indicated significant individual differences among students.
turkish_translation: Test skorlarındaki varyans, öğrenciler arasında önemli bireysel farklar olduğunu gösterdi.
collocations: statistical variance; variance analysis; population variance; variance component

definition: a group of atoms bonded together, representing the smallest fundamental unit of a chemical compound
example_sentence: Water molecules consist of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
turkish_translation: Su molekülleri iki hidrojen atomu ve bir oksijen atomundan oluşur.
collocations: organic molecule; molecule structure; complex molecule; molecule interaction

definition: an object or sign used to indicate position, place, or route; a distinguishing characteristic
example_sentence: Genetic markers helped researchers trace hereditary disease patterns in families.
turkish_translation: Genetik belirteçler araştırmacıların ailelerde kalıtsal hastalık kalıplarını izlemesine yardımcı oldu.
collocations: genetic marker; biological marker; marker gene; diagnostic marker

definition: based on, concerned with, or verifiable by observation or experience rather than theory
example_sentence: The empirical evidence strongly supported the theoretical predictions of the model.
turkish_translation: Ampirik kanıtlar modelin teorik öngörülerini güçlü şekilde destekledi.
collocations: empirical evidence; empirical research; empirical data; empirical study

definition: a machine designed to execute one or more tasks automatically with speed and precision
example_sentence: The surgical robot enhanced precision during complex medical procedures.
turkish_translation: Cerrahi robot, karmaşık tıbbi prosedürler sırasında hassasiyeti artırdı.
collocations: industrial robot; surgical robot; robot technology; autonomous robot

definition: relating to the use of statistics or statistical methods
example_sentence: The statistical analysis revealed significant differences between the experimental groups.
turkish_translation: İstatistiksel analiz deney grupları arasında anlamlı farklar ortaya koydu.
collocations: statistical analysis; statistical significance; statistical method; statistical data

definition: a speech sound produced without audible friction and forming the peak of a syllable
example_sentence: The phonetic study analyzed vowel production patterns across different languages.
turkish_translation: Fonetik çalışma farklı dillerde ünlü üretim kalıplarını analiz etti.
collocations: vowel sound; vowel system; long vowel; short vowel

definition: a state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced
example_sentence: The chemical system reached equilibrium after three hours of reaction time.
turkish_translation: Kimyasal sistem üç saatlik reaksiyon süresinden sonra dengeye ulaştı.
collocations: chemical equilibrium; thermal equilibrium; market equilibrium; dynamic equilibrium

definition: the quality of being intense; strength or force
example_sentence: The light intensity was carefully controlled to ensure consistent experimental conditions.
turkish_translation: Işık yoğunluğu tutarlı deneysel koşulları sağlamak için dikkatli şekilde kontrol edildi.
collocations: light intensity; sound intensity; exercise intensity; emotional intensity

definition: a return to a former or less developed state; a statistical technique
example_sentence: Multiple regression analysis identified the key factors influencing student performance.
turkish_translation: Çoklu regresyon analizi öğrenci performansını etkileyen temel faktörleri belirledi.
collocations: linear regression; multiple regression; regression analysis; regression coefficient

definition: the identification of the nature of an illness or other problem
example_sentence: Early diagnosis of the condition significantly improved treatment outcomes.
turkish_translation: Durumun erken teşhisi tedavi sonuçlarını önemli ölçüde iyileştirdi.
collocations: medical diagnosis; early diagnosis; differential diagnosis; diagnostic criteria

definition: the action or process of identifying someone or something
example_sentence: Species identification was performed using molecular genetic techniques.
turkish_translation: Tür tanımlaması moleküler genetik teknikler kullanılarak gerçekleştirildi.
collocations: species identification; problem identification; identification method; positive identification

definition: a point in a network or diagram at which lines or systems intersect or branch
example_sentence: Each node in the neural network processes information from multiple input sources.
turkish_translation: Sinir ağındaki her düğüm birden fazla giriş kaynağından bilgi işler.
collocations: network node; decision node; root node; leaf node

definition: a person or thing regarded as suitable for or likely to receive a particular treatment
example_sentence: The compound was identified as a promising candidate for drug development.
turkish_translation: Bileşik, ilaç geliştirme için umut veren bir aday olarak tanımlandı.
collocations: candidate gene; drug candidate; potential candidate; suitable candidate

definition: existing only in part; incomplete or limited
example_sentence: The partial results suggested a significant trend, but complete data was needed.
turkish_translation: Kısmi sonuçlar anlamlı bir eğilim gösterdi, ancak tam veriye ihtiyaç vardı.
collocations: partial results; partial correlation; partial derivative; partial pressure

definition: have a mutual relationship or connection in which one thing affects or depends on another
example_sentence: Physical activity levels correlate positively with overall health outcomes in longitudinal studies.
turkish_translation: Fiziksel aktivite seviyeleri uzunlamasına çalışmalarda genel sağlık sonuçlarıyla pozitif korelasyon gösterir.
collocations: strongly correlate; positively correlate; correlate with; significantly correlate

definition: the state of being subject to death; death rate in a population
example_sentence: The study examined infant mortality rates across different socioeconomic groups.
turkish_translation: Çalışma farklı sosyoekonomik gruplar arasında bebek ölüm oranlarını inceledi.
collocations: mortality rate; infant mortality; maternal mortality; mortality statistics

definition: a blood protein produced in response to and counteracting a specific antigen
example_sentence: The immune system produces antibodies to neutralize foreign pathogens in the body.
turkish_translation: Bağışıklık sistemi vücuttaki yabancı patojenleri etkisizleştirmek için antikor üretir.
collocations: antibody production; monoclonal antibody; antibody response; antibody test

definition: relating to time or occurring in time; lasting only for a limited period
example_sentence: The temporal sequence of events was crucial for understanding the causal relationships.
turkish_translation: Olayların zamansal sırası nedensel ilişkileri anlamak için kritikti.
collocations: temporal order; temporal lobe; temporal pattern; temporal dimension

definition: a minute portion of matter; a very small piece of something
example_sentence: Subatomic particles exhibit both wave and particle properties according to quantum mechanics.
turkish_translation: Atomaltı parçacıklar kuantum mekaniğine göre hem dalga hem de parçacık özelliklerini sergiler.
collocations: subatomic particle; particle physics; charged particle; particle size

definition: the time during which something continues or lasts
example_sentence: The duration of the treatment protocol was adjusted based on patient response rates.
turkish_translation: Tedavi protokolünün süresi hasta yanıt oranlarına göre ayarlandı.
collocations: treatment duration; study duration; short duration; extended duration

definition: relating to the way in which someone behaves or acts
example_sentence: The behavioral intervention showed significant improvements in classroom management.
turkish_translation: Davranışsal müdahale sınıf yönetiminde önemli iyileştirmeler gösterdi.
collocations: behavioral psychology; behavioral therapy; behavioral change; behavioral pattern

definition: the action of using up a resource or the amount of something consumed
example_sentence: Energy consumption patterns vary significantly between urban and rural communities.
turkish_translation: Enerji tüketim kalıpları kentsel ve kırsal topluluklar arasında önemli ölçüde farklılık gösterir.
collocations: energy consumption; food consumption; consumption patterns; sustainable consumption

definition: speaking two languages fluently; written or conducted in two languages
example_sentence: Bilingual education programs support students' native language while developing English proficiency.
turkish_translation: İki dilli eğitim programları İngilizce yeterlilik geliştirirken öğrencilerin ana dilini destekler.
collocations: bilingual education; bilingual speaker; bilingual program; bilingual advantage

definition: the quality of being sensitive; responsiveness to external conditions or stimuli
example_sentence: The instrument's sensitivity allowed detection of extremely low concentrations of the compound.
turkish_translation: Aletin hassasiyeti bileşiğin son derece düşük konsantrasyonlarının tespitine olanak sağladı.
collocations: sensitivity analysis; cultural sensitivity; sensitivity test; high sensitivity

definition: the state of being similar; resemblance in appearance, character, or quantity
example_sentence: The similarity between the two protein structures suggested a common evolutionary origin.
turkish_translation: İki protein yapısı arasındaki benzerlik ortak evrimsel köken olduğunu düşündürdü.
collocations: structural similarity; similarity measure; similarity analysis; striking similarity

definition: best or most favorable; achieving the best possible result under given conditions
example_sentence: The algorithm identified the optimal solution for minimizing computational complexity.
turkish_translation: Algoritma hesaplama karmaşıklığını minimize etmek için optimal çözümü belirledi.
collocations: optimal solution; optimal performance; optimal conditions; optimal strategy

definition: stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt
example_sentence: The research methodology provided explicit instructions for data collection procedures.
turkish_translation: Araştırma metodolojisi veri toplama prosedürleri için açık talimatlar sağladı.
collocations: explicit instruction; explicit knowledge; explicit consent; explicit criteria

definition: a change in the structure of a gene, resulting in a variant form
example_sentence: The genetic mutation was linked to increased susceptibility to certain diseases.
turkish_translation: Genetik mutasyon belirli hastalıklara yatkınlık artışıyla bağlantılıydı.
collocations: genetic mutation; point mutation; mutation rate; beneficial mutation

definition: relating to or characteristic of a colony or colonies
example_sentence: The colonial period significantly influenced the linguistic development of the region.
turkish_translation: Sömürge dönemi bölgenin dilsel gelişimini önemli ölçüde etkiledi.
collocations: colonial period; colonial history; colonial administration; post-colonial

definition: relating to phonology; concerning the sound system of a language
example_sentence: The phonological analysis revealed systematic patterns in sound changes across dialects.
turkish_translation: Fonolojik analiz lehçelerde ses değişikliklerinin sistematik kalıplarını ortaya çıkardı.
collocations: phonological system; phonological analysis; phonological rule; phonological awareness

definition: a complete range of different positions, opinions, etc. between two extreme positions
example_sentence: The electromagnetic spectrum encompasses all forms of electromagnetic radiation.
turkish_translation: Elektromanyetik spektrum tüm elektromanyetik radyasyon formlarını kapsar.
collocations: electromagnetic spectrum; visible spectrum; broad spectrum; autism spectrum

definition: the central and most important part of an object, movement, or group
example_sentence: The atomic nucleus contains protons and neutrons bound by strong nuclear forces.
turkish_translation: Atom çekirdeği güçlü nükleer kuvvetlerle bağlı proton ve nötronlar içerir.
collocations: atomic nucleus; cell nucleus; nucleus accumbens; galactic nucleus

definition: the beginning or start of something, especially something unpleasant
example_sentence: Early intervention programs can delay the onset of cognitive decline in elderly patients.
turkish_translation: Erken müdahale programları yaşlı hastalarda bilişsel gerilemenin başlangıcını geciktirebilir.
collocations: onset of disease; early onset; sudden onset; gradual onset

definition: the action or process of combining things to form a whole
example_sentence: The integration of technology in education requires comprehensive teacher training programs.
turkish_translation: Eğitimde teknoloji entegrasyonu kapsamlı öğretmen eğitimi programları gerektirir.
collocations: system integration; social integration; data integration; economic integration

definition: having power and influence over others; most important, powerful, or influential
example_sentence: The dominant theory in cognitive psychology emphasizes the role of mental schemas.
turkish_translation: Bilişsel psikolojideki baskın teori zihinsel şemaların rolünü vurgular.
collocations: dominant theory; dominant culture; dominant gene; dominant position

definition: a route or track; a sequence of reactions or processes
example_sentence: The metabolic pathway converts glucose into energy through a series of enzymatic reactions.
turkish_translation: Metabolik yolak bir dizi enzimatik reaksiyon yoluyla glukozu enerjiye dönüştürür.
collocations: metabolic pathway; neural pathway; signaling pathway; biochemical pathway

definition: organize the different parts of an activity so that they work together effectively
example_sentence: The research team coordinated data collection across multiple international sites.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibi birden fazla uluslararası merkez arasında veri toplamayı koordine etti.
collocations: coordinate efforts; coordinate activities; coordinate research; coordinate response

definition: a mathematical determination of the size or number of something
example_sentence: The statistical calculation revealed significant differences between treatment groups.
turkish_translation: İstatistiksel hesaplama tedavi grupları arasında anlamlı farklar ortaya çıkardı.
collocations: mathematical calculation; statistical calculation; complex calculation; accurate calculation

definition: come before something in time, order, or position
example_sentence: Symptoms of memory loss often precede the clinical diagnosis of dementia by several years.
turkish_translation: Hafıza kaybı belirtileri genellikle demans klinik teşhisinden birkaç yıl önce gelir.
collocations: precede in time; precede chronologically; events that precede

definition: a set of which all the elements are contained in another set

turkish_translation: Birleşmiş Milletler gerginliklerin tırmanmasını önlemek için genellikle çatışan ülkeler arasında arabuluculuk yapar.
collocations: mediate conflict; mediate dispute; mediate between; mediate negotiations

definition: an act of identifying something precisely or of stating a precise requirement
example_sentence: The technical specification document outlines all hardware and software requirements for the new system.
turkish_translation: Teknik şartname belgesi yeni sistem için tüm donanım ve yazılım gereksinimlerini belirtir.
collocations: technical specification; product specification; design specification; detailed specification

definition: to arrange in classes or categories according to shared qualities or characteristics
example_sentence: Biologists classify organisms based on their evolutionary relationships and morphological features.
turkish_translation: Biyologlar organizmaları evrimsel ilişkileri ve morfolojik özelliklerine göre sınıflandırırlar.
collocations: classify data; classify species; classify information; classify documents

definition: a person qualified to practice medicine; a doctor
example_sentence: The physician recommended lifestyle changes along with medication to manage the patient’s condition.
turkish_translation: Hekim hastanın durumunu yönetmek için ilaçla birlikte yaşam tarzı değişiklikleri önerdi.
collocations: attending physician; family physician; emergency physician; specialist physician

definition: the action of mathematical calculation; the use of computers to solve problems
example_sentence: Complex weather prediction requires massive computation involving millions of atmospheric variables.
turkish_translation: Karmaşık hava durumu tahmini milyonlarca atmosferik değişkeni içeren büyük hesaplamalar gerektirir.
collocations: numerical computation; parallel computation; quantum computation; computational complexity

definition: relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written
example_sentence: The oral examination tested students’ ability to communicate complex ideas verbally and spontaneously.
turkish_translation: Sözlü sınav öğrencilerin karmaşık fikirleri sözlü ve spontane şekilde iletme yetilerini test etti.
collocations: oral examination; oral presentation; oral tradition; oral history

definition: denoting the middle part or point of something
example_sentence: The research project is scheduled to conclude by mid-December after eighteen months of data collection.
turkish_translation: Araştırma projesi on sekiz aylık veri toplama sürecinden sonra Aralık ortasında tamamlanması planlanıyor.
collocations: mid-term; mid-point; mid-century; mid-range

definition: a thing that indicates the state or level of something; a sign or signal
example_sentence: The unemployment rate serves as a key economic indicator of a country’s financial health.
turkish_translation: İşsizlik oranı bir ülkenin finansal sağlığının temel ekonomik göstergesi olarak hizmet eder.
collocations: key indicator; performance indicator; economic indicator; health indicator

definition: a form or version of something that differs in some respect from other forms of the same thing
example_sentence: Scientists discovered a new genetic variant that may provide natural resistance to certain diseases.
turkish_translation: Bilim insanları belirli hastalıklara doğal direnç sağlayabilecek yeni bir genetik varyant keşfettiler.
collocations: genetic variant; language variant; virus variant; rare variant

definition: relating to the gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form
example_sentence: The evolutionary advantage of cooperation has been demonstrated in various animal species studies.
turkish_translation: İşbirliğinin evrimsel avantajı çeşitli hayvan türleri çalışmalarında gösterilmiştir.
collocations: evolutionary biology; evolutionary theory; evolutionary advantage; evolutionary process

definition: information about reactions to a product, performance, etc., used as a basis for improvement
example_sentence: Student feedback on course content helps instructors improve their teaching methods and materials.
turkish_translation: Ders içeriği hakkında öğrenci geri bildirimi eğitmenlerin öğretim yöntem ve materyallerini geliştirmelerine yardımcı olur.
collocations: positive feedback; constructive feedback; feedback loop; customer feedback

definition: done by people acting as a group; belonging to or shared by all members of a group
example_sentence: The collective effort of the research team resulted in groundbreaking discoveries in renewable energy.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibinin toplu çabası yenilenebilir enerji alanında çığır açan keşiflerle sonuçlandı.
collocations: collective action; collective responsibility; collective bargaining; collective memory

definition: based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system
example_sentence: The selection process seemed arbitrary, lacking clear criteria for evaluation and decision-making.
turkish_translation: Seçim süreci keyfi görünüyordu, değerlendirme ve karar verme için net kriterler yoktu.
collocations: arbitrary decision; arbitrary choice; arbitrary rule; arbitrary selection

definition: a numerical quantity that is not a whole number; a small or tiny part of something
example_sentence: Only a small fraction of the population has access to advanced medical treatments in rural areas.
turkish_translation: Nüfusun sadece küçük bir kesimi kırsal alanlarda ileri tıbbi tedavilere erişim sağlayabilmektedir.
collocations: small fraction; decimal fraction; fraction of cost; proper fraction

definition: a rough calculation of the value, number, quantity, or extent of something
example_sentence: The initial cost estimation for the construction project proved to be significantly lower than actual expenses.
turkish_translation: İnşaat projesi için ilk maliyet tahmini gerçek harcamalardan önemli ölçüde düşük çıktı.
collocations: cost estimation; population estimation; rough estimation; accurate estimation

definition: not denoting, involving, or arranged in a straight line; not having a proportional relationship
example_sentence: The nonlinear relationship between stress and performance shows that moderate stress can enhance productivity.
turkish_translation: Stres ve performans arasındaki doğrusal olmayan ilişki orta düzeyde stresin verimliliği artırabileceğini gösterir.
collocations: nonlinear equation; nonlinear relationship; nonlinear dynamics; nonlinear system

definition: closely and neatly packed together; having all the necessary components within a small space
example_sentence: The compact design of the new laboratory equipment allows for efficient use of limited workspace.
turkish_translation: Yeni laboratuvar ekipmanının kompakt tasarımı sınırlı çalışma alanının verimli kullanımına olanak sağlar.
collocations: compact design; compact disc; compact car; compact space

definition: the action of departing from an established course; a departure from usual or accepted standards
example_sentence: The standard deviation in test scores indicates the variability of student performance across the class.
turkish_translation: Test puanlarındaki standart sapma sınıf genelinde öğrenci performansının değişkenliğini gösterir.
collocations: standard deviation; deviation from norm; deviation analysis; statistical deviation

definition: a simplified drawing showing the appearance, structure, or workings of something
example_sentence: The flow diagram clearly illustrates the step-by-step process of protein synthesis in cells.
turkish_translation: Akış şeması hücrelerde protein sentezi sürecinin adım adım işleyişini açıkça göstermektedir.
collocations: flow diagram; schematic diagram; Venn diagram; organizational diagram

definition: relating to or situated in the region between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn
example_sentence: Tropical rainforests contain an extraordinary diversity of plant and animal species.
turkish_translation: Tropikal yağmur ormanları olağanüstü bitki ve hayvan türü çeşitliliği içerir.
collocations: tropical climate; tropical rainforest; tropical disease; tropical storm

definition: the study of the forms of things; the branch of biology dealing with the form and structure of organisms
example_sentence: Plant morphology research examines how environmental factors influence leaf shape and root development.
turkish_translation: Bitki morfolojisi araştırması çevresel faktörlerin yaprak şekli ve kök gelişimini nasıl etkilediğini inceler.
collocations: plant morphology; cell morphology; morphological analysis; comparative morphology

definition: by that means; as a result of that
example_sentence: The new software automates data entry, thereby reducing human error and increasing efficiency.
turkish_translation: Yeni yazılım veri girişini otomatikleştirerek insan hatasını azaltır ve verimliliği artırır.
collocations: thereby reducing; thereby increasing; thereby creating; thereby ensuring

definition: the arrangement of words and phrases to create well-formed sentences in a language
example_sentence: Programming languages have strict syntax rules that must be followed for code to execute properly.
turkish_translation: Programlama dillerinin kodun düzgün çalışması için uyulması gereken katı sözdizimi kuralları vardır.
collocations: syntax error; syntax rules; syntax analysis; correct syntax

definition: a shortcoming, imperfection, or lack in something
example_sentence: Quality control testing identified a manufacturing defect that could compromise product safety.
turkish_translation: Kalite kontrol testleri ürün güvenliğini tehlikeye atabilecek bir üretim kusuru tespit etti.
collocations: manufacturing defect; genetic defect; design defect; birth defect

definition: the action or state of moving or being moved apart
example_sentence: The separation of church and state is a fundamental principle in many democratic societies.
turkish_translation: Din ve devlet işlerinin ayrılması birçok demokratik toplumda temel bir ilkedir.
collocations: separation of powers; physical separation; separation anxiety; legal separation

definition: the process or state of converging; coming together from different directions
example_sentence: The convergence of artificial intelligence and biotechnology promises revolutionary advances in medicine.
turkish_translation: Yapay zeka ve biyoteknolojinin yakınsaması tıpta devrimsel ilerlemeler vaat ediyor.
collocations: convergence point; technological convergence; convergence theory; media convergence

definition: to a degree that is enough or adequate for a specific purpose
example_sentence: The sample size was sufficiently large to ensure statistical significance in the research findings.
turkish_translation: Örneklem büyüklüğü araştırma bulgularında istatistiksel anlamlılığı sağlamak için yeterince büyüktü.
collocations: sufficiently large; sufficiently detailed; sufficiently clear; sufficiently strong

definition: having a sound basis in logic or fact; reasonable or cogent
example_sentence: The experimental design must be valid to ensure that the results accurately reflect the phenomenon being studied.
turkish_translation: Deney tasarımı, sonuçların incelenen olguyu doğru şekilde yansıtmasını sağlamak için geçerli olmalıdır.
collocations: valid argument; valid reason; valid conclusion; statistically valid

definition: a point where two systems, subjects, organizations, etc. meet and interact
example_sentence: The user interface design significantly affects how easily people can navigate and use the software.
turkish_translation: Kullanıcı arayüzü tasarımı insanların yazılımda nasıl gezinip kullanabileceğini önemli ölçüde etkiler.
collocations: user interface; software interface; interface design; human-computer interface

definition: the emission of energy as electromagnetic waves or as moving subatomic particles
example_sentence: Solar radiation provides the energy that drives weather patterns and supports life on Earth.
turkish_translation: Güneş radyasyonu hava durumu kalıplarını yönlendiren ve Dünya’da yaşamı destekleyen enerjiyi sağlar.
collocations: solar radiation; electromagnetic radiation; radiation therapy; background radiation

definition: to fix firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass; to make something an integral part of something else
example_sentence: The company decided to embed sustainability principles into all aspects of their business operations.
turkish_translation: Şirket sürdürülebilirlik ilkelerini iş operasyonlarının tüm yönlerine entegre etmeye karar verdi.
collocations: embed in; embed deeply; embed permanently; embed code

definition: at right angles to a horizontal plane; upright or perpendicular
example_sentence: The vertical integration of the supply chain allowed the company to control costs more effectively.
turkish_translation: Tedarik zincirinin dikey entegrasyonu şirketin maliyetleri daha etkili kontrol etmesine olanak sağladı.
collocations: vertical axis; vertical integration; vertical position; vertical alignment

definition: having or showing a perceptive understanding; (of an angle) less than 90 degrees
example_sentence: The patient presented acute symptoms that required immediate medical intervention.
turkish_translation: Hasta acil tıbbi müdahale gerektiren akut semptomlar gösterdi.
collocations: acute angle; acute pain; acute illness; acute awareness

definition: the state of being useful, profitable, or beneficial; a public service providing electricity, gas, water, etc.
example_sentence: The utility of renewable energy sources becomes more apparent as fossil fuel costs continue to rise.
turkish_translation: Yenilenebilir enerji kaynaklarının faydası fosil yakıt maliyetleri artmaya devam ettikçe daha belirgin hale geliyor.
collocations: public utility; utility company; utility function; marginal utility

definition: a thing that completes or brings to perfection; the full number or quantity
example_sentence: The visual aids served as an excellent complement to the presenter’s verbal explanation.
turkish_translation: Görsel yardımcılar sunucunun sözlü açıklamasının mükemmel bir tamamlayıcısı oldu.
collocations: perfect complement; complement each other; full complement; complement system

definition: a flattened structure of a higher plant, typically green and blade-like
example_sentence: Each leaf on the plant contains chlorophyll that captures sunlight for photosynthesis.
turkish_translation: Bitkideki her yaprak fotosentez için güneş ışığını yakalayan klorofil içerir.
collocations: leaf structure; leaf blade; compound leaf; leaf photosynthesis

definition: relating to or in the form of words; spoken rather than written
example_sentence: The contract included both written clauses and verbal agreements made during negotiations.
turkish_translation: Sözleşme hem yazılı maddeler hem de müzakereler sırasında yapılan sözlü anlaşmaları içeriyordu.
collocations: verbal communication; verbal agreement; verbal skills; verbal reasoning

definition: a whole formed by combining several separate elements; the total or sum
example_sentence: The aggregate data from all participating schools revealed significant trends in student performance.
turkish_translation: Tüm katılımcı okullardan toplanan toplam veriler öğrenci performansında önemli eğilimleri ortaya koydu.
collocations: aggregate data; aggregate demand; aggregate score; in aggregate

definition: the state of being equal, especially in status, rights, and opportunities
example_sentence: The organization promotes gender equality through education and workplace policy reforms.
turkish_translation: Örgüt eğitim ve işyeri politikası reformları yoluyla cinsiyet eşitliğini teşvik ediyor.
collocations: gender equality; social equality; equality of opportunity; racial equality

definition: a collection of written texts, especially the entire works of a particular author or a body of writing on a particular subject
example_sentence: Researchers analyzed a large corpus of scientific literature to identify emerging trends in artificial intelligence.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar yapay zeka alanındaki yeni eğilimleri belirlemek için büyük bir bilimsel literatür derlemini analiz etti.
collocations: text corpus; linguistic corpus; corpus analysis; corpus linguistics

definition: a part of an organism consisting of an aggregate of tissues performing a specific function
example_sentence: The heart is a vital organ that pumps blood throughout the circulatory system.
turkish_translation: Kalp kan dolaşım sistemi boyunca kan pompalayan hayati bir organdır.
collocations: vital organ; organ transplant; organ system; organ function

definition: an increase or decrease in the magnitude of a property observed in passing from one point or moment to another
example_sentence: The temperature gradient across the lake creates distinct ecological zones with different species compositions.
turkish_translation: Göl boyunca sıcaklık gradyenti farklı tür kompozisyonlarına sahip belirgin ekolojik bölgeler oluşturur.
collocations: temperature gradient; pressure gradient; concentration gradient; steep gradient

definition: a system of methods used in a particular area of study or activity
example_sentence: The research methodology included both quantitative surveys and qualitative interviews to gather comprehensive data.
turkish_translation: Araştırma metodolojisi kapsamlı veri toplamak için hem nicel anketler hem de nitel görüşmeler içeriyordu.
collocations: research methodology; teaching methodology; scientific methodology; methodology section

definition: a thing with distinct and independent existence; a being or organization
example_sentence: Each business entity must comply with local regulations and tax requirements.
turkish_translation: Her iş varlığı yerel düzenlemeler ve vergi gereksinimlerine uymalıdır.
collocations: legal entity; business entity; separate entity; political entity

definition: a swelling of a part of the body, generally without inflammation, caused by an abnormal growth of tissue
example_sentence: Early detection of malignant tumors significantly improves treatment outcomes and survival rates.
turkish_translation: Malign tümörlerin erken teşhisi tedavi sonuçlarını ve yaşam oranlarını önemli ölçüde iyileştirir.
collocations: malignant tumor; benign tumor; brain tumor; tumor growth

definition: a thread or filament from which a vegetable tissue, mineral substance, or textile is formed
example_sentence: Dietary fiber plays a crucial role in maintaining digestive health and preventing certain diseases.
turkish_translation: Diyet lifi sindirim sağlığını korumada ve belirli hastalıkları önlemede önemli rol oynar.
collocations: dietary fiber; optical fiber; muscle fiber; synthetic fiber

definition: a typical example or pattern of something; a model or framework
example_sentence: The shift from traditional to digital marketing represents a fundamental paradigm change in business strategy.
turkish_translation: Gelenekselden dijital pazarlamaya geçiş iş stratejisinde temel bir paradigma değişimini temsil eder.
collocations: paradigm shift; new paradigm; dominant paradigm; paradigm change

definition: the scientific study of the human mind and its functions, especially those affecting behavior
example_sentence: Cognitive psychology examines how people process information, make decisions, and solve problems.
turkish_translation: Bilişsel psikoloji insanların bilgiyi nasıl işlediğini, karar verdiğini ve problem çözdüğünü inceler.
collocations: cognitive psychology; behavioral psychology; clinical psychology; developmental psychology

definition: limitless or endless in space, extent, or size; impossible to measure or calculate
example_sentence: The concept of infinite space challenges our understanding of the universe’s boundaries.
turkish_translation: Sonsuz uzay kavramı evrenin sınırları hakkındaki anlayışımıza meydan okur.
collocations: infinite space; infinite possibilities; infinite loop; infinite series

definition: showing a great deal of variety; very different
example_sentence: The diverse student population brings different perspectives and experiences to classroom discussions.
turkish_translation: Çeşitli öğrenci nüfusu sınıf tartışmalarına farklı bakış açıları ve deneyimler getirir.
collocations: diverse population; diverse backgrounds; diverse opinions; culturally diverse

definition: relating to the identification of the nature of an illness or other problem
example_sentence: Advanced diagnostic tools enable physicians to identify diseases at much earlier stages than before.
turkish_translation: Gelişmiş tanı araçları hekimlerin hastalıkları eskisinden çok daha erken aşamalarda tespit etmesini sağlar.
collocations: diagnostic test; diagnostic tool; diagnostic criteria; diagnostic imaging

definition: the unbroken and consistent existence or operation of something over time
example_sentence: The continuity of government operations during the crisis was maintained through emergency protocols.
turkish_translation: Kriz sırasında devlet operasyonlarının sürekliliği acil durum protokolleri aracılığıyla korundu.
collocations: business continuity; continuity planning; historical continuity; continuity of care

definition: the quality or state of being variable or changeable; lack of consistency
example_sentence: Climate variability makes long-term agricultural planning more challenging for farmers.
turkish_translation: İklim değişkenliği çiftçiler için uzun vadeli tarımsal planlamayı daha zorlu hale getirir.
collocations: genetic variability; climate variability; data variability; natural variability

definition: existing on the outside or external surface; situated farther from the center
example_sentence: The outer layers of the atmosphere protect Earth from harmful cosmic radiation.
turkish_translation: Atmosferin dış katmanları Dünya’yı zararlı kozmik radyasyondan korur.
collocations: outer space; outer layer; outer limits; outer surface

definition: a series or system of written symbols used to represent numbers, amounts, or elements
example_sentence: Mathematical notation provides a universal language for expressing complex equations and relationships.
turkish_translation: Matematiksel notasyon karmaşık denklemler ve ilişkileri ifade etmek için evrensel bir dil sağlar.
collocations: mathematical notation; scientific notation; musical notation; binary notation

definition: a thorough investigation into something; an unmanned exploratory spacecraft
example_sentence: The space probe transmitted valuable data about the planet’s atmospheric composition back to Earth.
turkish_translation: Uzay sondası gezegenin atmosferik bileşimi hakkında değerli verileri Dünya’ya geri iletti.
collocations: space probe; medical probe; probe investigation; DNA probe

definition: seasonal movement of animals from one region to another; movement from one part of something to another
example_sentence: Bird migration patterns are changing due to climate change and habitat loss.
turkish_translation: Kuş göç kalıpları iklim değişikliği ve habitat kaybı nedeniyle değişiyor.
collocations: bird migration; data migration; human migration; migration pattern

definition: relating to mathematics; characterized by the preciseness of mathematics
example_sentence: The mathematical model accurately predicted the population growth trends over the past decade.
turkish_translation: Matematiksel model son on yıldaki nüfus artış eğilimlerini doğru şekilde öngördü.
collocations: mathematical model; mathematical proof; mathematical equation; mathematical analysis

definition: the state or fact of something being likely; probability
example_sentence: The likelihood of success increases significantly with proper preparation and planning.
turkish_translation: Başarı olasılığı uygun hazırlık ve planlama ile önemli ölçüde artar.
collocations: high likelihood; likelihood ratio; likelihood function; statistical likelihood

definition: able to be likened to another; similar in size, quality, or quantity
example_sentence: The test results from both groups were comparable, indicating no significant difference in performance.
turkish_translation: Her iki gruptan alınan test sonuçları karşılaştırılabilirdi ve performansta önemli fark olmadığını gösteriyordu.
collocations: comparable results; comparable quality; comparable size; directly comparable

definition: the great size or extent of something; the degree of brightness of a star
example_sentence: The magnitude of the earthquake was measured at 7.2 on the Richter scale.
turkish_translation: Depremin büyüklüğü Richter ölçeğinde 7.2 olarak ölçüldü.
collocations: earthquake magnitude; order of magnitude; magnitude scale; stellar magnitude

definition: an impressive display or range of a particular type of thing; an ordered arrangement of items
example_sentence: The solar array on the spacecraft provides power for all onboard instruments and communication systems.
turkish_translation: Uzay aracındaki güneş panel dizisi tüm araç içi enstrümanlar ve iletişim sistemleri için güç sağlar.
collocations: solar array; antenna array; data array; vast array

definition: the action or state of including or of being included within a group or structure
example_sentence: The inclusion of diverse perspectives in the research team led to more comprehensive study results.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibinde çeşitli bakış açılarının dahil edilmesi daha kapsamlı çalışma sonuçlarına yol açtı.
collocations: social inclusion; inclusion criteria; inclusion policy; digital inclusion

definition: the production and discharge of something, especially gas, radiation, or sound
example_sentence: Carbon emission reduction is crucial for mitigating the effects of climate change globally.
turkish_translation: Karbon emisyonu azaltımı küresel iklim değişikliği etkilerini azaltmak için kritik önem taşır.
collocations: carbon emission; greenhouse gas emission; emission standards; emission control

definition: a conclusion reached on the basis of evidence and reasoning
example_sentence: The researchers made several important inferences about climate patterns from the ice core data.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar buz çekirdeği verilerinden iklim kalıpları hakkında birkaç önemli çıkarım yaptılar.
collocations: statistical inference; logical inference; causal inference; valid inference

definition: expressing negation or absence; not
example_sentence: The organization operates as a non-profit entity dedicated to environmental conservation.
turkish_translation: Örgüt çevre koruma amaçlı kar amacı gütmeyen bir kuruluş olarak faaliyet gösterir.
collocations: non-profit; non-verbal; non-fiction; non-toxic

definition: the state of being awake and aware of one’s surroundings; the awareness or perception of something
example_sentence: The study of consciousness remains one of the most challenging frontiers in neuroscience and philosophy.
turkish_translation: Bilinç çalışması nörobilim ve felsefedeki en zorlu sınırlardan biri olmaya devam ediyor.
collocations: human consciousness; consciousness studies; stream of consciousness; altered consciousness

definition: at the same time; occurring or done at the same moment
example_sentence: The coordinated experiment was conducted simultaneously at research facilities across three continents.
turkish_translation: Koordineli deney üç kıtadaki araştırma tesislerinde eş zamanlı olarak yürütüldü.
collocations: occur simultaneously; simultaneously with; work simultaneously; simultaneously recorded

definition: the interruption of a settled and peaceful condition; interference with a process or activity
example_sentence: The ecological disturbance caused by the wildfire affected wildlife populations for several years.
turkish_translation: Orman yangınının neden olduğu ekolojik bozulma yaban hayatı popülasyonlarını birkaç yıl etkiledi.
collocations: sleep disturbance; ecological disturbance; atmospheric disturbance; minimal disturbance

definition: a system in which members of an organization or society are ranked according to relative status or authority
example_sentence: The organizational hierarchy was restructured to improve communication and decision-making efficiency.
turkish_translation: Organizasyonel hiyerarşi iletişim ve karar verme verimliliğini artırmak için yeniden yapılandırıldı.
collocations: organizational hierarchy; social hierarchy; hierarchy of needs; administrative hierarchy

definition: the action of rotating around an axis or center; the regular succession of different things
example_sentence: The Earth’s rotation on its axis creates the cycle of day and night that governs biological rhythms.
turkish_translation: Dünya’nın kendi ekseni etrafındaki dönüşü biyolojik ritimleri yöneten gece-gündüz döngüsünü yaratır.
collocations: Earth’s rotation; crop rotation; job rotation; rotation speed

definition: appearing or occurring at intervals; happening repeatedly at regular times
example_sentence: The periodic table organizes chemical elements according to their atomic structure and properties.
turkish_translation: Periyodik tablo kimyasal elementleri atomik yapı ve özelliklerine göre organize eder.
collocations: periodic table; periodic review; periodic function; periodic maintenance

definition: the quality of being logically or factually sound; soundness or cogency
example_sentence: The validity of the research findings was confirmed through independent replication studies.
turkish_translation: Araştırma bulgularının geçerliliği bağımsız tekrarlama çalışmaları ile doğrulandı.
collocations: statistical validity; construct validity; content validity; external validity

definition: the study of human history and prehistory through the excavation and analysis of artifacts
example_sentence: Underwater archaeology has revealed important information about ancient maritime trade routes.
turkish_translation: Sualtı arkeolojisi antik denizcilik ticaret yolları hakkında önemli bilgiler ortaya koymuştur.
collocations: underwater archaeology; experimental archaeology; rescue archaeology; biblical archaeology

definition: the smallest unit of ordinary matter that forms a chemical element
example_sentence: Each atom consists of a nucleus containing protons and neutrons, surrounded by electrons.
turkish_translation: Her atom proton ve nötron içeren ve elektronlarla çevrili bir çekirdekten oluşur.
collocations: hydrogen atom; carbon atom; atomic structure; atom splitting

definition: the action of making changes to something; a change made to something
example_sentence: The software requires minor modifications to be compatible with the new operating system.
turkish_translation: Yazılımın yeni işletim sistemi ile uyumlu olması için küçük değişikliklere ihtiyacı vardır.
collocations: genetic modification; behavior modification; design modification; software modification

definition: a structure dividing a space into two parts; the action of dividing something into parts
example_sentence: The partition of the laboratory created separate areas for different types of experiments.
turkish_translation: Laboratuvarın bölünmesi farklı deney türleri için ayrı alanlar oluşturdu.
collocations: partition wall; hard drive partition; data partition; partition function

definition: to cause a process or action to begin; to admit someone into a secret or obscure society

definition: make sure or demonstrate that something is true, accurate, or justified
example_sentence: Independent researchers attempted to verify the original experimental findings.
turkish_translation: Bağımsız araştırmacılar orijinal deneysel bulguları doğrulamaya çalıştılar.
collocations: verify results; verify identity; independently verify; verify hypothesis

definition: rise and fall irregularly in number or amount
example_sentence: Exchange rates fluctuate daily depending on global market conditions.
turkish_translation: Döviz kurları küresel piyasa koşullarına bağlı olarak günlük olarak dalgalanır.
collocations: fluctuate wildly; wildly fluctuating; prices fluctuate; temperature fluctuates

definition: combine one thing with another so that they become a whole
example_sentence: The university aims to integrate technology seamlessly into traditional teaching methods.
turkish_translation: Üniversite, teknolojiyi geleneksel öğretim yöntemlerine sorunsuz bir şekilde entegre etmeyi amaçlamaktadır.
collocations: integrate into; fully integrate; integrate technology; integrate systems

definition: a part or element of a larger whole, especially a part of a machine or vehicle
example_sentence: Critical thinking is an essential component of higher education curricula.
turkish_translation: Eleştirel düşünme, yükseköğretim müfredatının temel bir bileşenidir.
collocations: key component; essential component; system component; structural component

definition: regard something as being caused by someone or something
example_sentence: Economists attribute the rise in inflation to supply chain disruptions.
turkish_translation: Ekonomistler enflasyondaki artışı tedarik zinciri aksamalarına bağlıyor.
collocations: attribute to; directly attribute; main attribute; essential attribute

definition: continuing firmly or obstinately in an opinion or course of action in spite of difficulty
example_sentence: Persistent drought conditions have led to severe water shortages across the region.
turkish_translation: Kalıcı/süregelen kuraklık koşulları, bölge genelinde ciddi su sıkıntısına yol açtı.
collocations: persistent problem; persistent effort; persistent symptoms; persistent belief

definition: make something suitable for a new use or purpose; modify
example_sentence: Species must adapt to changing environmental conditions to avoid extinction.
turkish_translation: Türlerin yok olmaktan kaçınmak için değişen çevre koşullarına uyum sağlaması gerekir.
collocations: adapt to; adapt quickly; adapt strategy; successfully adapt

definition: cause an event or situation to happen or exist
example_sentence: Environmental stress can trigger genetic mutations in susceptible organisms.
turkish_translation: Çevresel stres, duyarlı organizmalarda genetik mutasyonları tetikleyebilir.
collocations: trigger response; trigger reaction; main trigger; trigger event

definition: imitate the appearance or character of something
example_sentence: Computer models can simulate complex climate scenarios over centuries.
turkish_translation: Bilgisayar modelleri, yüzyıllar boyunca karmaşık iklim senaryolarını simüle edebilir.
collocations: simulate conditions; simulate environment; computer simulate; accurately simulate

definition: the extent of the area or subject matter that something deals with or to which it is relevant
example_sentence: The study's scope was limited to urban secondary schools in the region.
turkish_translation: Çalışmanın kapsamı bölgedeki kentsel ortaöğretim okulları ile sınırlandırılmıştır.
collocations: broad scope; limited scope; scope of study; beyond the scope

definition: strengthen or support physically or mentally; maintain over a period of time
example_sentence: High levels of investment are required to sustain economic growth.
turkish_translation: Ekonomik büyümeyi sürdürmek için yüksek düzeyde yatırım gereklidir.
collocations: sustain growth; sustain life; sustain damage; sustain effort

definition: showing a great deal of variety; very different
example_sentence: The university boasts a culturally diverse student body from over 100 countries.
turkish_translation: Üniversite, 100'den fazla ülkeden gelen kültürel açıdan çeşitli bir öğrenci kitlesine sahiptir.
collocations: diverse background; diverse views; culturally diverse; diverse range

definition: best or most favorable; achieving the best possible outcome
example_sentence: The algorithm seeks to find the optimal solution while minimizing computing power.
turkish_translation: Algoritma, işlem gücünü en aza indirirken optimal çözümü bulmaya çalışır.
collocations: optimal conditions; optimal performance; optimal result; optimal level

definition: strengthen or support an object, substance, or opinion
example_sentence: Recent experimental data reinforce the validity of the proposed theory.
turkish_translation: Son deneysel veriler önerilen teorinin geçerliliğini pekiştirmektedir.
collocations: reinforce learning; reinforce belief; reinforce structure; strongly reinforce

definition: recognize or point out a difference between people or things
example_sentence: It is essential to distinguish between correlation and causation in scientific analysis.
turkish_translation: Bilimsel analizde korelasyon ile nedensellik arasında ayrım yapmak şarttır.
collocations: distinguish between; clearly distinguish; distinguish feature; ability to distinguish

definition: place or arrange things in a straight line or in correct relative positions; bring into agreement
example_sentence: Educational goals must align with career market requirements.
turkish_translation: Eğitim hedefleri kariyer piyasasının gereksinimleriyle hizalanmalıdır/uyumlu olmalıdır.
collocations: align with; closely align; align goals; strategic alignment

definition: identify clearly and definitely; state a requirement explicitly
example_sentence: The contract must specify the exact delivery dates and payment terms.
turkish_translation: Sözleşme kesin teslimat tarihlerini ve ödeme koşullarını açıkça belirtmelidir.
collocations: clearly specify; specify details; explicitly specify; specify conditions

definition: make an action or process easy or easier
example_sentence: Modern software tools facilitate collaboration among international research teams.
turkish_translation: Modern yazılım araçları uluslararası araştırma ekipleri arasında işbirliğini kolaylaştırır.
collocations: facilitate learning; facilitate communication; facilitate process; greatly facilitate

definition: manifest or display a quality, feeling, or type of behavior
example_sentence: Patients with this genetic condition exhibit increased sensitivity to sunlight.
turkish_translation: Bu genetik duruma sahip hastalar güneş ışığına karşı artan bir hassasiyet sergilerler.
collocations: exhibit symptoms; exhibit behavior; exhibit properties; clearly exhibit

definition: change the form, character, or function of something
example_sentence: Solar panels convert sunlight into electrical energy efficiently.
turkish_translation: Güneş panelleri güneş ışığını verimli bir şekilde elektrik enerjisine dönüştürür.
collocations: convert into; convert energy; convert data; easily convert

definition: remove or take out, especially by effort or force
example_sentence: Researchers use specialized techniques to extract DNA from ancient bone samples.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar antik kemik örneklerinden DNA çıkarmak için özel teknikler kullanırlar.
collocations: extract data; extract DNA; extract information; extract value

definition: remove impurities or unwanted elements from; improve something by making small changes
example_sentence: Scientists continue to refine the model to improve prediction accuracy.
turkish_translation: Bilim insanları tahmin doğruluğunu artırmak için modeli iyileştirmeye/geliştirmeye devam ediyor.
collocations: refine method; refine technique; refine model; further refine

definition: handle or control a tool, mechanism, or data in a skillful manner
example_sentence: Statisticians can manipulate large datasets to reveal underlying trends.
turkish_translation: İstatistikçiler temel eğilimleri ortaya çıkarmak için büyük veri kümelerini yönlendirebilir/işleyebilirler.
collocations: manipulate data; manipulate variables; skillfully manipulate; genetic manipulation

definition: roughly calculate or judge the value, number, quantity, or extent of
example_sentence: Demographers estimate that the global population will peak by mid-century.
turkish_translation: Demograflar küresel nüfusun yüzyılın ortalarında zirveye ulaşacağını tahmin ediyor.
collocations: estimate cost; estimate size; roughly estimate; accurately estimate

definition: give someone something, typically money, in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury; counterbalance
example_sentence: The body attempts to compensate for oxygen loss by increasing heart rate.
turkish_translation: Vücut kalp atış hızını artırarak oksijen kaybını telafi etmeye çalışır.
collocations: compensate for; fully compensate; compensate loss; financially compensate

definition: cause something to pass on from one place or person to another
example_sentence: Nerve fibers transmit electrical signals rapidly to the central nervous system.
turkish_translation: Sinir lifleri elektrik sinyallerini merkezi sinir sistemine hızla iletir.
collocations: transmit signals; transmit data; transmit disease; wirelessly transmit

definition: make a statement or situation less confused and more comprehensible
example_sentence: The professor added an appendix to clarify complex mathematical proofs.
turkish_translation: Profesör karmaşık matematiksel ispatları açıklığa kavuşturmak için bir ek ekledi.
collocations: clarify meaning; clarify position; help clarify; further clarify

definition: gather together or acquire an increasing number or quantity of
example_sentence: Toxins can accumulate in animal tissues over prolonged exposure periods.
turkish_translation: Toksinler uzun süreli maruz kalma dönemlerinde hayvan dokularında birikebilir.
collocations: accumulate data; accumulate wealth; gradually accumulate; accumulate evidence

definition: become aware or conscious of something; come to realize or understand
example_sentence: Individuals perceive risk differently depending on personal experience and knowledge.
turkish_translation: Bireyler kişisel deneyim ve bilgi birikimlerine bağlı olarak riski farklı şekilde algılarlar.
collocations: perceive threat; perceive risk; clearly perceive; perceive as

definition: form an idea of the amount, number, or value of; assess
example_sentence: Researchers must evaluate the effectiveness of interventions using objective measures.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar müdahalelerin etkinliğini objektif ölçütler kullanarak değerlendirmelidir.
collocations: evaluate performance; evaluate impact; critically evaluate; evaluate effectiveness

definition: cause something, especially emotion or action, to arise or come about
example_sentence: Renewable energy technologies generate electricity without direct carbon emissions.
turkish_translation: Yenilenebilir enerji teknolojileri, doğrudan karbon emisyonu olmadan elektrik üretir.
collocations: generate power; generate income; generate interest; generate revenue

definition: put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect
example_sentence: Hospitals implemented new infection control measures during the outbreak.
turkish_translation: Hastaneler salgın sırasında yeni enfeksiyon kontrol önlemlerini uygulamaya koydu.
collocations: implement policy; implement strategy; successfully implement; implement changes

definition: intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or extent of
example_sentence: Regular physical exercise can significantly enhance cognitive performance.
turkish_translation: Düzenli fiziksel egzersiz bilişsel performansı önemli ölçüde artırabilir/geliştirebilir.
collocations: enhance quality; enhance performance; greatly enhance; enhance efficiency

definition: cause or enable a condition or state of affairs to continue; assert
example_sentence: The body works constantly to maintain homeostatic equilibrium.
turkish_translation: Vücut homeostatik dengeyi korumak için sürekli çalışır.
collocations: maintain balance; maintain standards; maintain contact; maintain control

definition: bring back a previous normal condition, situation, or feeling
example_sentence: Conservation programs aim to restore degraded coastal ecosystems.
turkish_translation: Koruma programları bozulmuş kıyı ekosistemlerini eski haline getirmeyi/restore etmeyi amaçlamaktadır.
collocations: restore balance; restore confidence; restore order; fully restore

definition: give special importance or prominence to something in speaking or writing
example_sentence: The curriculum emphasizes critical thinking and practical problem-solving skills.
turkish_translation: Müfredat eleştirel düşünme ve pratik problem çözme becerilerini vurgulamaktadır.
collocations: emphasize importance; strongly emphasize; emphasize need; emphasize role

definition: cause a process or action to begin
example_sentence: The institution plans to initiate a longitudinal study on youth development.
turkish_translation: Kurum, gençlik gelişimi üzerine uzunlamasına bir çalışma başlatmayı planlıyor.
collocations: initiate process; initiate contact; initiate discussion; initiate project

definition: put a limit on; keep under control
example_sentence: Ethical guidelines restrict the use of animal testing in cosmetic research.
turkish_translation: Etik kurallar kozmetik araştırmalarında hayvan deneylerinin kullanımını kısıtlamaktadır.
collocations: restrict access; severely restrict; restrict movement; restrict use

definition: provide sufficient space for; fit in with the wishes or needs of
example_sentence: The new facility was designed to accommodate up to 500 research scholars.
turkish_translation: Yeni tesis, 500 kadar araştırmacıyı barındıracak/ağırlayacak şekilde tasarlandı.
collocations: accommodate needs; accommodate growth; accommodate changes; easily accommodate

definition: make partial or minor changes to something, typically so as to improve it
example_sentence: Engineers modified the original design to improve aerodynamic efficiency.
turkish_translation: Mühendisler, aerodinamik verimliliği artırmak için orijinal tasarımı değiştirdi/değişikliğe uğrattı.
collocations: modify behavior; modify structure; slightly modify; genetically modify

definition: control or maintain the rate or speed of a process so that it operates properly
example_sentence: Hormones regulate various metabolic processes within the human body.
turkish_translation: Hormonlar insan vücudundaki çeşitli metabolik süreçleri düzenler.
collocations: regulate temperature; strictly regulate; regulate market; regulate body

definition: make a thorough or dramatic change in the form, appearance, or character of
example_sentence: Digital technology has transformed how academic research is conducted and shared.
turkish_translation: Dijital teknoloji, akademik araştırmaların yürütülme ve paylaşılma şeklini dönüştürdü.
collocations: completely transform; transform lives; transform industry; transform society

definition: completely remove or get rid of something
example_sentence: The new manufacturing technique helps eliminate material waste during production.
turkish_translation: Yeni üretim tekniği, üretim sırasında malzeme israfını ortadan kaldırmaya yardımcı oluyor.
collocations: eliminate risk; completely eliminate; eliminate waste; eliminate errors

definition: take in or contain something as part of a whole; include
example_sentence: The revised framework incorporates feedback from international peer reviewers.
turkish_translation: Gözden geçirilmiş çerçeve, uluslararası hakemlerin geri bildirimlerini bünyesine katmaktadır/içermektedir.
collocations: incorporate into; fully incorporate; incorporate feedback; incorporate features

definition: distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose
example_sentence: The committee decided to allocate additional funding to medical research projects.
turkish_translation: Komite, tıp araştırmaları projelerine ek fon tahsis etmeye karar verdi.
collocations: allocate resources; allocate budget; allocate funds; allocate time

definition: set up an organization, system, or set of rules on a firm or permanent basis
