example_sentence: The researchers aimed to establish a causal relationship between the two variables.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar iki değişken arasında nedensel bir ilişki kurmayı/tespit etmeyi amaçladılar.
collocations: establish contact; establish relationship; establish framework; firmly establish

definition: clearly show the existence or truth of something by giving proof or evidence
example_sentence: Clinical trials demonstrate the safety and efficacy of the new vaccine candidate.
turkish_translation: Klinik deneyler, yeni aşı adayının güvenliğini ve etkinliğini kanıtlamaktadır/göstermektedir.
collocations: demonstrate competence; clearly demonstrate; demonstrate capability; demonstrate effectiveness

definition: be a part of a whole; combine to form something
example_sentence: Small and medium-sized enterprises constitute the vast majority of local businesses.
turkish_translation: Küçük ve orta ölçekli işletmeler, yerel işletmelerin ezici çoğunluğunu oluşturmaktadır.
collocations: constitute majority; constitute threat; constitute basis; legally constitute

definition: settle or find a solution to a problem or dispute
example_sentence: Diplomatic negotiations helped resolve the border dispute peacefully.
turkish_translation: Diplomatik müzakereler sınır anlaşmazlığının barışçıl bir şekilde çözülmesine yardımcı oldu.
collocations: resolve conflict; resolve issue; successfully resolve; resolve crisis

definition: cause a person or place to be or remain alone or apart from others
example_sentence: Laboratory technicians were able to isolate the compound responsible for the reaction.
turkish_translation: Laboratuvar teknisyenleri reaksiyondan sorumlu bileşiği izole etmeyi/ayıştırmayı başardılar.
collocations: isolate gene; isolate virus; completely isolate; isolate variable

definition: carry out a formal inquiry or systematic study to discover facts
example_sentence: The study was conducted to investigate the impact of sleep deprivation on memory.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, uyku yoksunluğunun hafıza üzerindeki etkisini araştırmak amacıyla yürütülmüştür.
collocations: thoroughly investigate; investigate cause; investigate effect; investigate incident

definition: check or prove the validity or accuracy of something
example_sentence: Further empirical studies are required to validate the theoretical findings.
turkish_translation: Teorik bulguları doğrulamak/geçerli kılmak için ek ampirik çalışmalara ihtiyaç vardır.
collocations: validate model; validate findings; empirically validate; validate claim

definition: plan and direct the course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport; manage a complex situation
example_sentence: Organizations must learn to navigate complex regulatory environments successfully.
turkish_translation: Kuruluşlar karmaşık düzenleyici ortamlarda başarıyla yol almayı/yön bulmayı öğrenmelidir.
collocations: navigate system; navigate terrain; successfully navigate; navigate challenge

definition: evaluate or estimate the nature, ability, or quality of
example_sentence: Standardized tests are used to assess student learning outcomes at the end of the year.
turkish_translation: Yıl sonunda öğrenci öğrenme çıktılarını değerlendirmek için standartlaştırılmış testler kullanılır.
collocations: assess risk; assess impact; assess quality; accurately assess

definition: produce a list or report by assembling information collected from other sources
example_sentence: The research team spent months compiling data from national census records.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibi ulusal nüfus sayımı kayıtlarından veri derlemek için aylar harcadı.
collocations: compile data; compile report; compile list; comprehensive compile

definition: point out; show; be a sign or symptom of
example_sentence: Preliminary results indicate that the new treatment is safe and effective.
turkish_translation: Ön sonuçlar yeni tedavinin güvenli ve etkili olduğunu göstermektedir/işaret etmektedir.
collocations: clearly indicate; strongly indicate; results indicate; data indicate

definition: strongly suggest the truth or existence of something not expressly stated
example_sentence: The research findings imply that current educational policies need significant reform.
turkish_translation: Araştırma bulguları mevcut eğitim politikalarının ciddi bir reforma ihtiyacı olduğunu ima etmektedir/göstermektedir.
collocations: strongly imply; imply that; research implies; necessarily imply

definition: cause something to occur in a particular way; be the decisive factor in
example_sentence: Genetics and environment together determine an individual's susceptibility to diseases.
turkish_translation: Genetik ve çevre birlikte bireyin hastalıklara yatkınlığını belirler.
collocations: determine cause; determine factor; accurately determine; predetermine

definition: regard as probable; expect or predict
example_sentence: Economists anticipate a gradual recovery in consumer spending over the coming quarters.
turkish_translation: Ekonomistler önümüzdeki çeyreklerde tüketici harcamalarında kademeli bir toparlanma öngörüyorlar/bekliyorlar.
collocations: anticipate change; eagerly anticipate; anticipate need; anticipate outcome

definition: use or add in place of something else
example_sentence: Researchers attempted to substitute natural plant extracts for synthetic preservatives.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar sentetik koruyucuların yerine doğal bitki özlerini ikame etmeye/kullanmaya çalıştılar.
collocations: substitute for; direct substitute; substitute ingredient; substitute method

definition: act against something in order to reduce its force or neutralize it
example_sentence: Regular exercise can counteract the negative health impacts of a sedentary lifestyle.
turkish_translation: Düzenli egzersiz, hareketsiz bir yaşam tarzının olumsuz sağlık etkilerini nötralize edebilir/karşı koyabilir.
collocations: counteract effect; counteract impact; help counteract; effectively counteract

definition: explain or make something clear by using examples, charts, or diagrams
example_sentence: The case study serves to illustrate how the theoretical model works in practice.
turkish_translation: Vaka çalışması, teorik modelin uygulamada nasıl çalıştığını örneklendirmeye/resmetmeye yarar.
collocations: clearly illustrate; illustrate point; diagram illustrates; serve to illustrate

definition: express an idea or feeling fluently and coherently
example_sentence: Students must be able to articulate their research findings clearly in oral presentations.
turkish_translation: Öğrenciler sözlü sunumlarda araştırma bulgularını açıkça ifade edebilmelidir.
collocations: clearly articulate; articulate vision; articulate thought; articulate argument

definition: put forward an idea or plan for consideration or discussion by others
example_sentence: The lead author proposed a new theoretical framework for analyzing language acquisition.
turkish_translation: Başyazar dil edinimini analiz etmek için yeni bir teorik çerçeve önerdi.
collocations: propose theory; propose model; propose solution; propose changes

definition: succeed in achieving something that one desires and has worked for
example_sentence: Students must attain a minimum score of 70% to qualify for advanced courses.
turkish_translation: Öğrencilerin ileri düzey derslere hak kazanabilmeleri için en az %70 puan elde etmeleri/ulaşmaları gerekir.
collocations: attain goal; attain level; attain success; difficult to attain

definition: a solid inorganic substance of natural occurrence
example_sentence: Essential mineral deficiencies can significantly impact human health and development.
turkish_translation: Temel mineral eksiklikleri insan sağlığını ve gelişimini önemli ölçüde etkileyebilir.

definition: relating to or situated on the edge or periphery of something
example_sentence: Peripheral vision plays a crucial role in spatial awareness and navigation.
turkish_translation: Periferik görme uzamsal farkındalık ve navigasyonda kritik rol oynar.

definition: performed or occurring as a result of sudden inner impulse without premeditation
example_sentence: Spontaneous recovery often occurs in certain neurological conditions.
turkish_translation: Belirli nörolojik durumlarında kendiliğinden iyileşme sıklıkla görülür.

definition: the quality of being trustworthy or performing consistently well
example_sentence: Statistical reliability ensures that research measurements are consistent and accurate.
turkish_translation: İstatistiksel güvenirlik araştırma ölçümlerinin tutarlı ve doğru olmasını sağlar.

definition: an organism or cell produced asexually from one ancestor; an identical copy
example_sentence: Therapeutic clone research offers potential treatments for degenerative diseases.
turkish_translation: Terapötik klon araştırması dejeneratif hastalıklar için potansiyel tedaviler sunar.

definition: to align or position with respect to points of the compass or other specific positions
example_sentence: Students must orient themselves to new academic environments and expectations.
turkish_translation: Öğrenciler kendilerini yeni akademik ortamlar ve beklentilere göre yönlendirmelidir.

definition: involving many carefully arranged parts or details; detailed and complicated in design
example_sentence: The research proposal included an elaborate methodology section with detailed procedures.
turkish_translation: Araştırma önerisi detaylı prosedürlerle birlikte kapsamlı bir metodoloji bölümü içeriyordu.

definition: existing in name only; very small; insignificant
example_sentence: The nominal fee for library services ensures accessibility for all students.
turkish_translation: Kütüphane hizmetleri için nominal ücret tüm öğrenciler için erişilebilirliği sağlar.

definition: to place, fit, or thrust something into another thing
example_sentence: Researchers insert genetic markers to track cellular processes in living organisms.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar canlı organizmalarda hücresel süreçleri takip etmek için genetik işaretleyiciler yerleştirir.

definition: the production of offspring by a sexual or asexual process; the action of copying something
example_sentence: Digital reproduction technology preserves historical documents for future generations.
turkish_translation: Dijital çoğaltma teknolojisi tarihi belgeleri gelecek nesiller için korur.

definition: power and influence over others; the state of being dominant
example_sentence: Market dominance by large corporations can limit competition and innovation.
turkish_translation: Büyük şirketlerin pazar hakimiyeti rekabeti ve yeniliği sınırlayabilir.

definition: the action of distributing resources or duties for a particular purpose
example_sentence: Budget allocation for research projects requires careful consideration of priorities.
turkish_translation: Araştırma projeleri için bütçe tahsisi önceliklerin dikkatli değerlendirilmesini gerektirir.

definition: each of the pair of organs in the chest that enable breathing
example_sentence: Lung function tests assess respiratory health and detect potential diseases.
turkish_translation: Akciğer fonksiyon testleri solunum sağlığını değerlendirir ve potansiyel hastalıkları tespit eder.

definition: producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities
example_sentence: Productive collaboration between researchers accelerates scientific discoveries.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar arasındaki verimli işbirliği bilimsel keşifleri hızlandırır.

definition: the process of rotting or decomposition; gradual decline
example_sentence: Radioactive decay is an important concept in physics research.
turkish_translation: Radyoaktif bozunma fizik araştırmalarında önemli bir kavramdır.

definition: aware of and responding to one’s surroundings; deliberate
example_sentence: Conscious effort to reduce bias improves research methodology quality.
turkish_translation: Önyargıyı azaltmak için bilinçli çaba araştırma metodolojisi kalitesini artırır.

definition: the distance through an object from one surface to the opposite surface
example_sentence: Material thickness affects thermal insulation properties in building construction.
turkish_translation: Malzeme kalınlığı bina yapımında termal yalıtım özelliklerini etkiler.

definition: to cause something to pass on from one place or person to another
example_sentence: Digital networks transmit vast amounts of information across global distances.
turkish_translation: Dijital ağlar küresel mesafeler boyunca büyük miktarda bilgi aktarır.

definition: to become pregnant; to form an idea or plan in the mind
example_sentence: Scientists conceive innovative hypotheses through creative thinking processes.
turkish_translation: Bilim insanları yaratıcı düşünme süreçleri yoluyla yenilikçi hipotezler tasarlar.

definition: the young born of living organisms; a person’s children or descendants
example_sentence: Genetic studies track trait transmission from parents to offspring across generations.
turkish_translation: Genetik çalışmalar nesiller boyunca ebeveynlerden yavrulara özellik aktarımını takip eder.

definition: to have qualities or features in common with someone or something; be like
example_sentence: The new synthetic material closely resembles natural silk in texture and appearance.
turkish_translation: Yeni sentetik malzeme doku ve görünüm açısından doğal ipeğe çok benziyor.

definition: movement to and fro or around something; the continuous movement of blood through the body
example_sentence: Proper blood circulation is essential for delivering nutrients to all body tissues.
turkish_translation: Uygun kan dolaşımı tüm vücut dokularına besin maddeleri ulaştırmak için gereklidir.

definition: in a way that is accurate or true; without error
example_sentence: Students must correctly interpret statistical data to draw valid conclusions.
turkish_translation: Öğrenciler geçerli sonuçlar çıkarmak için istatistiksel verileri doğru şekilde yorumlamalıdır.

definition: the fact of being required or indispensable; essential requirement
example_sentence: Clean water access is a basic necessity for human survival and development.
turkish_translation: Temiz su erişimi insan yaşamı ve gelişimi için temel bir gerekliliktir.

definition: a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable
example_sentence: Scientific metaphors help explain complex concepts through familiar comparisons.
turkish_translation: Bilimsel metaforlar tanıdık karşılaştırmalar yoluyla karmaşık kavramları açıklamaya yardımcı olur.

definition: a large area of land; a system of organs or tissues with a particular function
example_sentence: The digestive tract processes nutrients through a series of specialized organs.
turkish_translation: Sindirim sistemi bir dizi özel organ aracılığıyla besin maddelerini işler.

definition: a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and produces bile
example_sentence: Liver function tests monitor hepatic health and detect potential diseases.
turkish_translation: Karaciğer fonksiyon testleri hepatik sağlığı izler ve potansiyel hastalıkları tespit eder.

definition: based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions
example_sentence: Subjective assessments complement objective measurements in psychological research.
turkish_translation: Öznel değerlendirmeler psikolojik araştırmalarda nesnel ölçümleri tamamlar.

definition: to gather together or acquire an increasing number or quantity of
example_sentence: Research evidence continues to accumulate supporting the effectiveness of the intervention.
turkish_translation: Müdahalenin etkinliğini destekleyen araştırma kanıtları birikmeye devam ediyor.

definition: the dismissing or refusing of a proposal, idea, etc.; the action of spurning a person’s affections
example_sentence: Peer review involves the potential rejection of manuscripts that don’t meet quality standards.
turkish_translation: Hakem değerlendirmesi kalite standartlarını karşılamayan makalelerin potansiyel reddini içerir.

definition: to make as large or great as possible; optimize
example_sentence: Educational programs aim to maximize student learning outcomes through personalized approaches.
turkish_translation: Eğitim programları kişiselleştirilmiş yaklaşımlar yoluyla öğrenci öğrenme çıktılarını maksimuma çıkarmayı hedefler.

definition: the action of replacing someone or something; a person or thing that takes the place of another
example_sentence: Artificial joint replacement surgery significantly improves mobility for arthritis patients.
turkish_translation: Yapay eklem replasmanı ameliyatı artrit hastaları için hareketliliği önemli ölçüde iyileştirir.

definition: in the middle of; surrounded by; in the group of
example_sentence: Collaborative research amongst institutions accelerates scientific progress worldwide.
turkish_translation: Kurumlar arasındaki işbirlikçi araştırma dünya çapında bilimsel ilerlemeyi hızlandırır.

definition: a circumstance that complicates or makes difficult; a medical condition that arises during treatment
example_sentence: Surgical complications can be minimized through careful preoperative planning.
turkish_translation: Cerrahi komplikasyonlar dikkatli preoperatif planlama yoluyla en aza indirilebilir.

definition: more than one in number; relating to or consisting of more than one
example_sentence: Plural perspectives enhance understanding of complex social phenomena.
turkish_translation: Çoğul perspektifler karmaşık sosyal olguları anlamayı geliştirir.

definition: a device for controlling the passage of fluid through a pipe or duct
example_sentence: Heart valve replacement procedures require specialized cardiac surgical expertise.
turkish_translation: Kalp kapağı replasmanı prosedürleri özelleşmiş kardiyak cerrahi uzmanlığı gerektirir.

definition: the process of taking in or soaking up; complete attention or engagement
example_sentence: Nutrient absorption in the intestines depends on various physiological factors.
turkish_translation: Bağırsaklardaki besin emilimi çeşitli fizyolojik faktörlere bağlıdır.

definition: relating to money or currency
example_sentence: Monetary incentives can influence research participation rates significantly.
turkish_translation: Parasal teşvikler araştırma katılım oranlarını önemli ölçüde etkileyebilir.

definition: relating to heat or temperature
example_sentence: Thermal regulation mechanisms help organisms maintain optimal body temperature.
turkish_translation: Termal düzenleme mekanizmaları organizmaların optimal vücut sıcaklığını korumalarına yardımcı olur.

definition: in the same way; also; similarly
example_sentence: Physical exercise benefits mental health; likewise, cognitive activities enhance physical wellbeing.
turkish_translation: Fiziksel egzersiz ruh sağlığına fayda sağlar; aynı şekilde bilişsel aktiviteler fiziksel refahı geliştirir.

definition: the ability or willingness to tolerate something; allowable amount of variation
example_sentence: Cultural tolerance promotes peaceful coexistence in diverse communities.
turkish_translation: Kültürel hoşgörü çeşitli topluluklarda barışçıl bir arada yaşamayı destekler.

definition: having or showing the ability to speak fluently and coherently
example_sentence: Articulate communication skills are essential for effective academic presentations.
turkish_translation: Açık iletişim becerileri etkili akademik sunumlar için gereklidir.

definition: a person who gives something, especially to a charity; someone who provides organs for transplant
example_sentence: Organ donor programs save thousands of lives through successful transplant procedures.
turkish_translation: Organ bağışçısı programları başarılı nakil prosedürleri yoluyla binlerce hayat kurtarır.

definition: continuous change; the action or process of flowing
example_sentence: Scientific knowledge exists in constant flux as new discoveries challenge existing theories.
turkish_translation: Bilimsel bilgi yeni keşifler mevcut teorilere meydan okudukça sürekli değişim halindedir.

definition: the ability to move or be moved freely and easily
example_sentence: Social mobility opportunities depend significantly on educational access and quality.
turkish_translation: Sosyal hareketlilik fırsatları eğitim erişimi ve kalitesine önemli ölçüde bağlıdır.

definition: the action of manipulating something or someone; skillful handling or operation
example_sentence: Data manipulation techniques allow researchers to analyze complex datasets effectively.
turkish_translation: Veri manipülasyon teknikleri araştırmacıların karmaşık veri setlerini etkili şekilde analiz etmesine olanak tanır.

definition: to lift up or raise to a higher position; to raise to a more important level
example_sentence: Quality education programs elevate students’ critical thinking and analytical skills.
turkish_translation: Kaliteli eğitim programları öğrencilerin eleştirel düşünme ve analitik becerilerini yükseltir.

definition: patriotic feeling, principles, or efforts; advocacy of political independence
example_sentence: Cultural nationalism can preserve heritage while promoting inclusive social policies.
turkish_translation: Kültürel milliyetçilik kapsayıcı sosyal politikaları desteklerken mirası koruyabilir.

definition: a comparison between two things, typically for the purpose of explanation or clarification
example_sentence: Teachers use analogies to help students understand complex scientific concepts.
turkish_translation: Öğretmenler öğrencilerin karmaşık bilimsel kavramları anlamasına yardımcı olmak için analojiler kullanır.

definition: preventing success or development; harmful or unfavorable
example_sentence: Adverse weather conditions can significantly impact agricultural productivity and crop yields.
turkish_translation: Olumsuz hava koşulları tarımsal verimlilik ve mahsul verimini önemli ölçüde etkileyebilir.

definition: a chemical element that is a colorless, odorless gas forming about 78% of the atmosphere
example_sentence: Nitrogen fixation by bacteria is essential for plant protein synthesis.
turkish_translation: Bakteriler tarafından azot fiksasyonu bitki protein sentezi için gereklidir.

definition: seeming reasonable or probable; appearing worthy of belief
example_sentence: The researcher presented a plausible explanation for the unexpected results.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacı beklenmedik sonuçlar için makul bir açıklama sundu.

definition: a blood vessel that carries blood toward the heart; a distinctive quality or style
example_sentence: The research explored decision-making processes in a similar vein to previous studies.
turkish_translation: Araştırma önceki çalışmalara benzer bir tarzda karar verme süreçlerini inceledi.

definition: prolonged public disagreement or heated discussion
example_sentence: The genetic engineering research sparked significant ethical controversy.
turkish_translation: Genetik mühendisliği araştırması önemli etik tartışma yarattı.

definition: a cereal plant whose grain is used to make flour for bread, pasta, and other foods
example_sentence: Wheat production has increased significantly through modern agricultural techniques.
turkish_translation: Buğday üretimi modern tarım teknikleri sayesinde önemli ölçüde artmıştır.

definition: to write again, especially in a different or improved form
example_sentence: The authors decided to rewrite the methodology section for greater clarity.
turkish_translation: Yazarlar daha fazla netlik için metodoloji bölümünü yeniden yazmaya karar verdiler.

definition: done with the hands; requiring physical skill and energy
example_sentence: Manual data entry processes are being replaced by automated systems.
turkish_translation: Manuel veri giriş süreçleri otomatik sistemlerle değiştirilmektedir.

definition: relating to the identification of long-term goals and the means of achieving them
example_sentence: Strategic planning is essential for successful research program development.
turkish_translation: Stratejik planlama başarılı araştırma programı geliştirme için gereklidir.

definition: a poor farmer of low social status who owns or rents a small piece of land
example_sentence: Historical research examines peasant life during medieval agricultural periods.
turkish_translation: Tarihsel araştırma ortaçağ tarım dönemlerinde köylü yaşamını inceler.

definition: to take in or soak up; to understand or learn information
example_sentence: Students need time to absorb complex theoretical concepts thoroughly.
turkish_translation: Öğrencilerin karmaşık teorik kavramları tamamen özümsemesi için zamana ihtiyacı vardır.

definition: a rough or unfinished drawing or painting, often made to assist in making a more finished picture
example_sentence: The architect’s preliminary sketch outlined the building’s innovative design.
turkish_translation: Mimarın ön eskizi, binanın yenilikçi tasarımını ana hatlarıyla çizdi.

definition: the action of showing something to be right or reasonable
example_sentence: The professor demanded a clear justification for the research methodology.
turkish_translation: Profesör, araştırma metodolojisi için açık bir gerekçe istedi.

definition: the length of time for which a person or organism lives or a thing functions
example_sentence: She dedicated her lifetime to advancing educational opportunities for women.
turkish_translation: Hayatını kadınlar için eğitim fırsatlarını geliştirmeye adadı.

definition: relating to, composed of, or involving two things
example_sentence: The binary classification system divides organisms into two distinct categories.
turkish_translation: İkili sınıflandırma sistemi organizmaları iki farklı kategoriye ayırır.

definition: clearly stated or decided; not vague or doubtful
example_sentence: The committee reached a definite conclusion about the funding proposal.
turkish_translation: Komite finansman teklifi hakkında kesin bir sonuca vardı.

definition: an outline representing or bounding the shape or form of something
example_sentence: The topographical map clearly shows the contour lines of the mountain.
turkish_translation: Topografik harita dağın eş yükselti eğrilerini açıkça gösteriyor.

definition: the carrying out or putting into effect of a plan, order, or course of action
example_sentence: The successful execution of the project required careful coordination among teams.
turkish_translation: Projenin başarılı şekilde yürütülmesi takımlar arasında dikkatli koordinasyon gerektirdi.

definition: a strong, regular, repeated pattern of movement or sound
example_sentence: The poet’s use of rhythm creates a musical quality in the verse.
turkish_translation: Şairin ritim kullanımı dizede müziksel bir kalite yaratıyor.

definition: being or happening at the end of a process; final
example_sentence: The ultimate goal of the research is to develop sustainable energy solutions.
turkish_translation: Araştırmanın nihai amacı sürdürülebilir enerji çözümleri geliştirmektir.

definition: a book or electronic resource that lists words in alphabetical order and gives their meaning
example_sentence: Students are encouraged to use a comprehensive dictionary when writing essays.
turkish_translation: Öğrenciler makale yazarken kapsamlı bir sözlük kullanmaya teşvik edilir.

definition: a body of fundamental principles or established precedents according to which a state is governed
example_sentence: The new constitution guarantees equal rights for all citizens.
turkish_translation: Yeni anayasa tüm vatandaşlar için eşit hakları garanti ediyor.

definition: increase in rate or speed of something
example_sentence: The acceleration of technological advancement has transformed modern society.
turkish_translation: Teknolojik ilerlemenin hızlanması modern toplumu dönüştürdü.

definition: to damage or weaken someone or something, especially gradually or insidiously
example_sentence: Constant criticism can undermine a student’s confidence in their abilities.
turkish_translation: Sürekli eleştiri, öğrencinin yeteneklerine olan güvenini sarsabilir.

definition: an unfavorable circumstance or condition that reduces the chances of success
example_sentence: Students from low-income families often face educational disadvantages.
turkish_translation: Düşük gelirli ailelerden gelen öğrenciler genellikle eğitimsel dezavantajlarla karşılaşır.

definition: a widely held but false belief or idea
example_sentence: The myth that learning becomes harder with age has been scientifically debunked.
turkish_translation: Yaşla birlikte öğrenmenin zorlaştığı efsanesi bilimsel olarak çürütülmüştür.

definition: a single thin length of something such as thread, fiber, or wire
example_sentence: The researcher examined each strand of DNA under the microscope.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacı DNA’nın her bir telini mikroskop altında inceledi.

definition: to make or become united, uniform, or whole
example_sentence: The new policy aims to unify educational standards across the country.
turkish_translation: Yeni politika ülke genelinde eğitim standartlarını birleştirmeyi amaçlıyor.

definition: without method or conscious decision; in a way governed by chance
example_sentence: Participants were randomly assigned to either the control or experimental group.
turkish_translation: Katılımcılar rastgele olarak kontrol veya deney grubuna atandı.

definition: a person engaged or learned in philosophy, especially as an academic discipline
example_sentence: The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle made significant contributions to logic.
turkish_translation: Antik Yunan filozofu Aristoteles mantık alanında önemli katkılarda bulundu.

definition: to say a word or part of a word in a particular way
example_sentence: Many students struggle to pronounce words correctly in their second language.
turkish_translation: Birçok öğrenci ikinci dillerinde kelimeleri doğru telaffuz etmekte zorlanır.

definition: a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject
example_sentence: The professional development workshop focused on innovative teaching methodologies.
turkish_translation: Mesleki gelişim çalıştayı yenilikçi öğretim metodolojilerine odaklandı.

definition: an expression or feeling of disapproval or opposition; a reason for disagreeing
example_sentence: The committee raised several objections to the proposed research methodology.
turkish_translation: Komite önerilen araştırma metodolojisine birkaç itiraz yöneltti.

definition: having a serious, important, or useful quality or purpose
example_sentence: The research aims to establish meaningful connections between theory and practice.
turkish_translation: Araştırma, teori ve pratik arasında anlamlı bağlantılar kurmayı amaçlıyor.

definition: the distance between successive crests of a wave, especially points in electromagnetic radiation
example_sentence: Different colors of light correspond to different wavelengths in the electromagnetic spectrum.
turkish_translation: Işığın farklı renkleri elektromanyetik spektrumdaki farklı dalga boylarına karşılık gelir.

definition: to identify the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms
example_sentence: Advanced imaging techniques help doctors diagnose diseases more accurately.
turkish_translation: Gelişmiş görüntüleme teknikleri doktorların hastalıkları daha doğru teşhis etmesine yardımcı olur.

definition: a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular region or social group
example_sentence: The professor spoke English with a slight foreign accent but was easily understood.
turkish_translation: Profesör İngilizceyi hafif yabancı aksanla konuşuyordu ama kolayca anlaşılıyordu.

definition: a field or domain of activity or interest
example_sentence: The discovery opened new possibilities in the realm of quantum physics.
turkish_translation: Keşif, kuantum fiziği alanında yeni olanaklar açtı.

definition: the action of copying or reproducing something
example_sentence: The replication of the experiment confirmed the original findings.
turkish_translation: Deneyin tekrarlanması orijinal bulguları doğruladı.

definition: a bowl-shaped depression or hollow in the ground, especially one containing water
example_sentence: The research team studied the geological formation of the river basin.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibi nehir havzasının jeolojik oluşumunu inceledi.

definition: the process or fact of entering or being allowed to enter a place or organization
example_sentence: University admission requirements have become increasingly competitive in recent years.
turkish_translation: Üniversite kabul şartları son yıllarda giderek daha rekabetçi hale geldi.

definition: in a way that arouses curiosity or interest
example_sentence: Interestingly, the results contradicted the researchers’ initial hypothesis.
turkish_translation: İlginç bir şekilde, sonuçlar araştırmacıların ilk hipotezini çürüttü.

definition: to make something clear or easier to understand by giving more details or a simpler explanation
example_sentence: The professor asked students to clarify their research questions before proceeding.
turkish_translation: Profesör öğrencilerden devam etmeden önce araştırma sorularını netleştirmelerini istedi.

definition: a network of lines that cross each other to form a series of squares or rectangles
example_sentence: The urban planner designed the city streets in a regular grid pattern.
turkish_translation: Şehir plancısı şehir sokaklarını düzenli bir ızgara deseninde tasarladı.

definition: the subjects comprising a course of study in a school or college
example_sentence: The university revised its curriculum to include more practical applications.
turkish_translation: Üniversite müfredatını daha fazla pratik uygulama içerecek şekilde revize etti.

definition: the moving of something from its place or position
example_sentence: The war caused massive displacement of civilian populations.
turkish_translation: Savaş sivil nüfusun büyük çaplı yerinden edilmesine neden oldu.

definition: logical and consistent; forming a unified whole
example_sentence: The student presented a coherent argument supported by solid evidence.
turkish_translation: Öğrenci sağlam kanıtlarla desteklenen tutarlı bir argüman sundu.

definition: to cause something to conform to a standard
example_sentence: The international committee worked to standardize testing procedures across countries.
turkish_translation: Uluslararası komite ülkeler arası test prosedürlerini standartlaştırmak için çalıştı.

definition: the stage of human social and cultural development and organization that is considered most advanced
example_sentence: Ancient Mesopotamian civilization laid the foundation for modern urban planning.
turkish_translation: Antik Mezopotamya uygarlığı modern kent planlamasının temellerini attı.

definition: in a positive way; with optimism, confidence, or approval
example_sentence: Students responded positively to the new interactive learning methods.
turkish_translation: Öğrenciler yeni etkileşimli öğrenme yöntemlerine olumlu tepki verdi.

definition: relating to bacteria
example_sentence: The laboratory studies bacterial resistance to various antibiotics.
turkish_translation: Laboratuvar çeşitli antibiyotiklere karşı bakteriyel direnci inceler.

definition: a lack or shortage of something essential
example_sentence: The study revealed a significant vitamin D deficiency among urban populations.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, kentsel nüfus arasında önemli bir D vitamini eksikliği olduğunu ortaya koydu.

definition: conforming to the law or to rules; able to be defended with logic or justification
example_sentence: The researchers raised legitimate concerns about the experimental design.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar deney tasarımı hakkında meşru endişeler dile getirdi.

definition: to make something more complex, refined, or developed
example_sentence: Modern technology has helped sophisticate our understanding of climate patterns.
turkish_translation: Modern teknoloji iklim paternlerini anlamamızı daha sofistike hale getirdi.

definition: to begin to move more quickly or to cause something to move faster
example_sentence: The new funding will accelerate research into renewable energy solutions.
turkish_translation: Yeni finansman, yenilenebilir enerji çözümleri araştırmasını hızlandıracak.

definition: becoming more and more rapid in growth or progress
example_sentence: The exponential growth of data requires increasingly sophisticated storage solutions.
turkish_translation: Verinin üstel büyümesi giderek daha sofistike depolama çözümleri gerektiriyor.

definition: in accordance with official rules, customs, or procedures
example_sentence: The university formally recognized the student organization last semester.
turkish_translation: Üniversite geçen dönem öğrenci organizasyonunu resmi olarak tanıdı.

definition: in a way that relates to society or to the way society is organized
example_sentence: The program aims to help students develop socially responsible leadership skills.
turkish_translation: Program öğrencilerin toplumsal sorumluluk sahibi liderlik becerileri geliştirmesini amaçlıyor.

definition: in a way that is correct in all details; exactly
example_sentence: The instrument can accurately measure temperature changes to within 0.1 degrees.
turkish_translation: Alet sıcaklık değişimlerini 0.1 derece hassasiyetle doğru şekilde ölçebilir.

definition: having great influence on someone or something
example_sentence: The professor’s influential research shaped modern understanding of cognitive development.
turkish_translation: Profesörün etkili araştırması bilişsel gelişimin modern anlayışını şekillendirdi.

definition: the process of developing or moving gradually towards a more advanced state
example_sentence: The student’s progression from basic to advanced concepts was remarkably rapid.
turkish_translation: Öğrencinin temel kavramlardan ileri düzey kavramlara ilerlemesi dikkat çekici derecede hızlıydı.

definition: to handle or control typically in a skillful manner
example_sentence: Researchers must carefully manipulate variables to ensure valid experimental results.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar geçerli deneysel sonuçlar elde etmek için değişkenleri dikkatli şekilde manipüle etmelidir.

definition: the intrinsic nature or indispensable quality of something
example_sentence: The essence of scientific research is the systematic pursuit of knowledge.
turkish_translation: Bilimsel araştırmanın özü, sistematik bilgi arayışıdır.

definition: a solid geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular cross-section
example_sentence: The engine contains six cylinders that work in precise coordination.
turkish_translation: Motor, hassas koordinasyon içinde çalışan altı silindir içerir.

definition: academic study or achievement; learning at a high level
example_sentence: Her exceptional scholarship earned her recognition from international academic institutions.
turkish_translation: Olağanüstü bilimsel çalışması ona uluslararası akademik kurumlardan tanınma kazandırdı.

definition: a chemical element, a soft silver-white metal that is highly reactive
example_sentence: Excessive sodium intake is linked to increased risk of cardiovascular disease.
turkish_translation: Aşırı sodyum alımı kardiyovasküler hastalık riskinin artmasıyla bağlantılıdır.

definition: mainly; for the most part
example_sentence: The university’s student body is predominantly composed of international students.
turkish_translation: Üniversitenin öğrenci topluluğu ağırlıklı olarak uluslararası öğrencilerden oluşuyor.

definition: a sudden strong and unreflective urge or desire to act
example_sentence: The researcher’s impulse to explore led to a groundbreaking discovery.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacının keşfetme dürtüsü çığır açan bir keşfe yol açtı.

definition: repetitive variation, typically in time, of some measure about a central value
example_sentence: The pendulum’s oscillation demonstrates fundamental principles of physics.
turkish_translation: Sarkacın salınımı fiziğin temel ilkelerini gösterir.

definition: a person who develops or studies the theoretical framework of a subject
example_sentence: The prominent theorist challenged conventional wisdom in educational psychology.
turkish_translation: Önde gelen teorisyen eğitim psikolojisindeki geleneksel anlayışa meydan okudu.

definition: a union or association formed for mutual benefit
example_sentence: The research alliance between universities facilitates knowledge sharing.
turkish_translation: Üniversiteler arasındaki araştırma ittifakı bilgi paylaşımını kolaylaştırıyor.

definition: a piece of a homogeneous solid substance having a natural geometrically regular form
example_sentence: The research team analyzed the crystal structure using advanced X-ray techniques.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibi kristal yapısını gelişmiş X-ışını teknikleri kullanarak analiz etti.

definition: used to emphasize a significant point
example_sentence: The study found several trends, but most importantly, it revealed a need for policy reform.
turkish_translation: Çalışma birkaç eğilim buldu, ama en önemlisi, politika reformu ihtiyacını ortaya koydu.

definition: a pile of objects, typically one that is neatly arranged
example_sentence: The librarian organized the research papers into neat stacks by topic.
turkish_translation: Kütüphaneci araştırma makalelerini konulara göre düzenli yığınlar halinde organize etti.

definition: to be carried slowly by a current of air or water
example_sentence: The conversation began to drift away from the main research topic.
turkish_translation: Konuşma ana araştırma konusundan uzaklaşmaya başladı.

definition: a structure built by birds or other animals to hold their eggs or young
example_sentence: The biologist studied the nest-building behavior of urban bird populations.
turkish_translation: Biyolog kentsel kuş popülasyonlarının yuva yapma davranışını inceledi.

definition: the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form
example_sentence: The newly discovered fossil provides evidence of early mammalian evolution.
turkish_translation: Yeni keşfedilen fosil, erken memeli evriminin kanıtını sağlıyor.

definition: relating to or having dimensions
example_sentence: The architect created a three-dimensional model of the proposed library building.
turkish_translation: Mimar önerilen kütüphane binasının üç boyutlu modelini oluşturdu.

definition: offering resistance to something or someone
example_sentence: The new material is highly resistant to both heat and chemical corrosion.
turkish_translation: Yeni malzeme hem ısıya hem de kimyasal korozyona karşı oldukça dirençli.

definition: the infliction or imposition of a penalty as retribution for an offense
example_sentence: The study examined the effectiveness of punishment versus rehabilitation in criminal justice.
turkish_translation: Çalışma ceza adaletinde cezalandırma ile rehabilitasyonun etkinliğini inceledi.

definition: the art of effective or persuasive speaking or writing
example_sentence: The politician’s rhetoric was analyzed for its persuasive techniques and logical structure.
turkish_translation: Politikacının retoriği ikna edici teknikleri ve mantıksal yapısı açısından analiz edildi.

definition: an object made by a human being, typically of cultural or historical interest
example_sentence: The museum displayed ancient artifacts from Mesopotamian civilizations.
turkish_translation: Müze Mezopotamya uygarlıklarından antik eserleri sergiledi.

definition: a person or thing that carries, holds, or conveys something
example_sentence: The postal carrier delivered important research documents to the university.
turkish_translation: Posta taşıyıcısı üniversiteye önemli araştırma belgelerini teslim etti.

definition: relating to or used in surgery
example_sentence: The medical team used advanced surgical techniques for the complex procedure.
turkish_translation: Tıp ekibi karmaşık işlem için gelişmiş cerrahi teknikler kullandı.

definition: the organization of the different elements of a complex body or activity
example_sentence: Successful research projects require excellent coordination between team members.
turkish_translation: Başarılı araştırma projeleri ekip üyeleri arasında mükemmel koordinasyon gerektirir.

definition: very disturbed or characterized by conflict, disorder, or confusion
example_sentence: The research was conducted during a turbulent period in the country’s political history.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ülkenin siyasi tarihinde çalkantılı bir dönemde yapıldı.

definition: a discrete quantity of energy proportional in magnitude to the frequency of radiation
example_sentence: Quantum mechanics revolutionized our understanding of atomic and subatomic processes.
turkish_translation: Kuantum mekaniği atomik ve atom altı süreçlere dair anlayışımızı devrimleştirdi.

definition: matter that settles to the bottom of a liquid
example_sentence: Geologists analyzed sediment layers to understand the region’s geological history.
turkish_translation: Jeologlar bölgenin jeolojik tarihini anlamak için sediment katmanlarını analiz etti.

definition: a narrow beam of light, heat, or other energy
example_sentence: The physicist studied how gamma rays interact with different materials.
turkish_translation: Fizikçi gama ışınlarının farklı malzemelerle nasıl etkileştiğini inceledi.

definition: to protect something from harm or destruction
example_sentence: The national park was established to conserve endangered species and their habitats.
turkish_translation: Milli park, nesli tükenmekte olan türleri ve habitatlarını korumak için kuruldu.

definition: an elementary textbook that serves as an introduction to a subject
example_sentence: The professor recommended a comprehensive primer on statistical analysis for beginners.
turkish_translation: Profesör yeni başlayanlar için kapsamlı bir istatistiksel analiz başlangıç kitabı önerdi.

definition: to understand something clearly and completely
example_sentence: It took several lectures for students to fully grasp the complex theoretical concepts.
turkish_translation: Öğrencilerin karmaşık teorik kavramları tam olarak kavraması birkaç ders aldı.

definition: the mass or size of something large
example_sentence: The bulk of the research data was collected during the summer months.
turkish_translation: Araştırma verilerinin büyük kısmı yaz aylarında toplandı.

definition: the body of terms used with a particular technical application in a subject
example_sentence: Students must master the scientific terminology before proceeding to advanced courses.
turkish_translation: Öğrenciler ileri derslere geçmeden önce bilimsel terminolojiyi öğrenmelidir.

definition: plants considered collectively, especially those found in a particular area
example_sentence: Climate change is significantly affecting vegetation patterns in Arctic regions.
turkish_translation: İklim değişikliği Arktik bölgelerdeki bitki örtüsü modellerini önemli ölçüde etkiliyor.

definition: a plane figure with three straight sides and three angles
example_sentence: The architect incorporated triangular designs to create structurally sound buildings.
turkish_translation: Mimar yapısal olarak sağlam binalar yaratmak için üçgen tasarımlar kullandı.

definition: according to tradition; in a way that follows established customs
example_sentence: Universities have traditionally emphasized theoretical knowledge over practical skills.
turkish_translation: Üniversiteler geleneksel olarak pratik becerilere göre teorik bilgiyi vurgulamıştır.

definition: to carry out or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action
example_sentence: The research team must execute the experimental protocol precisely to ensure valid results.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibi geçerli sonuçlar elde etmek için deneysel protokolü tam olarak uygulamalıdır.

definition: concentrated on a single area or subject or into a short time; very thorough or vigorous
example_sentence: The intensive training program prepared students for advanced research methodologies.
turkish_translation: Yoğun eğitim programı öğrencileri ileri araştırma metodolojilerine hazırladı.

definition: to build something again after it has been damaged or destroyed
example_sentence: Historians attempt to reconstruct ancient civilizations using archaeological evidence.
turkish_translation: Tarihçiler arkeolojik kanıtları kullanarak antik uygarlıkları yeniden inşa etmeye çalışır.

definition: in general and with regard to the essential features
example_sentence: The research findings can be broadly applied to similar educational contexts worldwide.
turkish_translation: Araştırma bulguları dünya çapında benzer eğitim bağlamlarına genel olarak uygulanabilir.

definition: the chemical processes that occur within a living organism to maintain life
example_sentence: Regular exercise can significantly improve your body’s metabolism and energy levels.
turkish_translation: Düzenli egzersiz vücudunuzun metabolizmasını ve enerji seviyelerini önemli ölçüde iyileştirebilir.

definition: involving or causing a complete or dramatic change
example_sentence: The discovery of CRISPR technology represents a revolutionary advancement in genetic engineering.
turkish_translation: CRISPR teknolojisinin keşfi genetik mühendisliğinde devrimsel bir ilerlemeyi temsil ediyor.

definition: to combine or cause to combine to form a single entity
example_sentence: The two research departments will merge to create a more comprehensive program.
turkish_translation: İki araştırma departmanı daha kapsamlı bir program oluşturmak için birleşecek.

definition: a situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between alternatives
example_sentence: Researchers face an ethical dilemma when balancing scientific progress with participant safety.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar bilimsel ilerleme ile katılımcı güvenliğini dengeleme konusunda etik bir ikilemle karşılaşıyor.

definition: a decorative design or recurring theme
example_sentence: The researcher identified a recurring motif in the participants’ responses to stress.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacı, katılımcıların strese verdikleri yanıtlarda tekrarlayan bir motif belirledi.

definition: a reason for doing or behaving in a particular way
example_sentence: Understanding the motive behind student behavior is crucial for effective teaching.
turkish_translation: Öğrenci davranışının arkasındaki güdüyü anlamak etkili öğretim için çok önemlidir.

definition: so delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe
example_sentence: The researcher detected subtle changes in brain activity during the cognitive task.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacı bilişsel görev sırasında beyin aktivitesinde ince değişiklikleri tespit etti.

definition: a medical facility that is primarily devoted to the care of outpatients
example_sentence: The university opened a new psychology clinic to provide community mental health services.
turkish_translation: Üniversite toplum ruh sağlığı hizmetleri sağlamak için yeni bir psikoloji kliniği açtı.

definition: to distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose
example_sentence: The research committee will allocate funding based on the scientific merit of proposals.
turkish_translation: Araştırma komitesi tekliflerin bilimsel değerine göre finansman ayıracak.

definition: a colorless, odorless, highly flammable gas, the chemical element of atomic number 1
example_sentence: Scientists are exploring hydrogen as a clean alternative fuel source for transportation.
turkish_translation: Bilim insanları hidrojeni ulaşım için temiz alternatif yakıt kaynağı olarak araştırıyor.

definition: a long essay on a particular subject, especially one written for a university degree
example_sentence: Her doctoral dissertation explored the relationship between social media and political engagement.
turkish_translation: Doktora tezi sosyal medya ve siyasi katılım arasındaki ilişkiyi araştırdı.

definition: likely or liable to be influenced or harmed by a particular thing
example_sentence: Young children are more susceptible to environmental toxins than adults.
turkish_translation: Küçük çocuklar çevresel toksinlere yetişkinlerden daha duyarlıdır.

definition: a person who designs buildings and in many cases also supervises their construction
example_sentence: The renowned architect designed sustainable buildings that minimize environmental impact.
turkish_translation: Ünlü mimar çevresel etkiyi minimize eden sürdürülebilir binalar tasarladı.

definition: relating to the arteries that supply blood to the heart muscle
example_sentence: Regular exercise significantly reduces the risk of coronary heart disease.
turkish_translation: Düzenli egzersiz koroner kalp hastalığı riskini önemli ölçüde azaltır.

definition: a failure of a relationship or system; an analysis of something into its component parts
example_sentence: The research provides a detailed breakdown of educational spending by category.
turkish_translation: Araştırma kategorilere göre eğitim harcamalarının ayrıntılı dökümünü sunuyor.

definition: to introduce something into something else, especially by force
example_sentence: The new curriculum aims to inject creativity into traditional science education.
turkish_translation: Yeni müfredat geleneksel fen eğitimine yaratıcılık katmayı amaçlıyor.

definition: an expert in economics; a person who studies or writes about economics
example_sentence: The prominent economist warned about the potential impacts of inflation on education funding.
turkish_translation: Önde gelen ekonomist enflasyonun eğitim finansmanı üzerindeki potansiyel etkilerini uyardı.

definition: the quantity of motion of a moving body; impetus gained by a developing process
example_sentence: The educational reform movement is gaining momentum across the country.
turkish_translation: Eğitim reformu hareketi ülke genelinde ivme kazanıyor.

definition: relating to the North or South Pole; having opposite extremes
example_sentence: The debate revealed polar opposite views on the effectiveness of standardized testing.
turkish_translation: Tartışma standart testlerin etkinliği konusunda kutupsal zıt görüşleri ortaya koydu.

definition: directed behind or to the rear; having made less progress than normal
example_sentence: The region’s backward educational infrastructure requires significant investment and modernization.
turkish_translation: Bölgenin geri kalmış eğitim altyapısı önemli yatırım ve modernizasyon gerektiriyor.

definition: to increase in number or quantity; to perform mathematical multiplication
example_sentence: Social media platforms multiply the speed at which information spreads globally.
turkish_translation: Sosyal medya platformları bilginin küresel olarak yayılma hızını artırıyor.

definition: principles concerning the distinction between right and wrong or good and bad behavior
example_sentence: The philosophy course examines questions of morality in contemporary society.
turkish_translation: Felsefe dersi çağdaş toplumda ahlak sorularını inceler.

definition: ready to talk or impart information; relating to communication
example_sentence: The new teaching method emphasizes communicative language learning over grammar memorization.
turkish_translation: Yeni öğretim yöntemi dilbilgisi ezberleme yerine iletişimsel dil öğrenimini vurgular.

definition: in a way that relates to the body as opposed to the mind
example_sentence: Students who are physically active tend to perform better academically than sedentary peers.
turkish_translation: Fiziksel olarak aktif olan öğrenciler, hareketsiz yaşıtlarından akademik olarak daha iyi performans gösterme eğilimindedir.

definition: the fall of rain; the amount of rain that falls
example_sentence: Climate researchers study how changing rainfall patterns affect agricultural productivity.
turkish_translation: İklim araştırmacıları değişen yağış modellerinin tarımsal üretkenliği nasıl etkilediğini inceler.

definition: in a way that relates to politics or government
example_sentence: The education reform proposal is politically controversial but academically sound.
turkish_translation: Eğitim reformu teklifi politik olarak tartışmalı ama akademik olarak sağlam.

definition: an instance of invading a country or region with an armed force
example_sentence: The historian studied the long-term effects of the Norman invasion on English language development.
turkish_translation: Tarihçi Norman istilasının İngilizce dilinin gelişimi üzerindeki uzun vadeli etkilerini inceledi.

definition: as is certain to happen; unavoidably
example_sentence: Technology will inevitably transform traditional teaching methods in higher education.
turkish_translation: Teknoloji kaçınılmaz olarak yükseköğretimde geleneksel öğretim yöntemlerini dönüştürecek.

definition: an economic and political system in which trade and industry are controlled by private owners
example_sentence: The sociology course examines the relationship between capitalism and social inequality.
turkish_translation: Sosyoloji dersi kapitalizm ve sosyal eşitsizlik arasındaki ilişkiyi inceler.

definition: expert skill or knowledge in a particular area
example_sentence: The research team combined expertise from multiple disciplines to address complex environmental challenges.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibi karmaşık çevresel zorlukları ele almak için birden fazla disiplinden uzmanlığı birleştirdi.

definition: lower in rank, status, or quality
example_sentence: The study found no evidence that online education is inferior to traditional classroom instruction.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, çevrimiçi eğitimin geleneksel sınıf öğretiminden aşağı olduğuna dair hiçbir kanıt bulamadı.

definition: in an active manner; with energy and determination
example_sentence: Students who actively participate in class discussions demonstrate better comprehension of the material.
turkish_translation: Sınıf tartışmalarına aktif olarak katılan öğrenciler materyali daha iyi anladıklarını gösterir.

definition: a group of words taken from a text or speech and repeated by someone other than the original author
example_sentence: The research paper included relevant quotations from leading experts in the field.
turkish_translation: Araştırma makalesi alandaki önde gelen uzmanlardan ilgili alıntıları içeriyordu.

definition: made up of various parts or elements
example_sentence: The final grade is a composite score based on exams, assignments, and participation.
turkish_translation: Final notu sınavlar, ödevler ve katılıma dayalı bileşik bir puandır.

definition: with regard to history or past events
example_sentence: Universities have historically been centers of intellectual and social progress.
turkish_translation: Üniversiteler tarihsel olarak entelektüel ve sosyal ilerlemenin merkezleri olmuştur.

definition: a book used as a standard work for the study of a particular subject
example_sentence: The professor assigned a comprehensive textbook that covers all major theories in psychology.
turkish_translation: Profesör psikolojideki tüm ana teorileri kapsayan kapsamlı bir ders kitabı atadı.

definition: a collection of things or quantity of material tied or wrapped up together
example_sentence: The software bundle includes all the necessary tools for statistical analysis.
turkish_translation: Yazılım paketi istatistiksel analiz için gerekli tüm araçları içerir.

definition: relating to the most rudimentary aspects of a subject
example_sentence: The course begins with elementary concepts before progressing to advanced topics.
turkish_translation: Ders ileri konulara geçmeden önce temel kavramlarla başlar.

definition: a person who uses their wealth to invest in trade and industry for profit
example_sentence: The economic historian studied the role of early capitalists in industrial development.
turkish_translation: Ekonomi tarihçisi erken dönem kapitalistlerin endüstriyel kalkınmadaki rolünü inceledi.

definition: the quality of bending easily without breaking; willingness to change or compromise
example_sentence: Online learning offers students greater flexibility in managing their study schedules.
turkish_translation: Çevrimiçi öğrenme öğrencilere çalışma programlarını yönetmekte daha fazla esneklik sunar.

definition: thin rope made of twisted strands; an electrical cable
example_sentence: The researcher carefully organized all electrical cords to ensure laboratory safety.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacı laboratuvar güvenliğini sağlamak için tüm elektrik kablolarını dikkatli şekilde düzenledi.

definition: the action of beginning something or introducing someone to an activity
example_sentence: The initiation of the new research program required extensive planning and coordination.
turkish_translation: Yeni araştırma programının başlatılması kapsamlı planlama ve koordinasyon gerektirdi.

definition: having or showing a sensible and practical idea of what can be achieved
example_sentence: Students need realistic expectations about the time required to master complex subjects.
turkish_translation: Öğrencilerin karmaşık konuları öğrenmek için gereken zaman konusunda gerçekçi beklentileri olması gerekir.

definition: the line at which the earth’s surface and the sky appear to meet; the limit of one’s knowledge or experience
example_sentence: New technologies continue to expand the horizon of possibilities in medical research.
turkish_translation: Yeni teknolojiler tıp araştırmalarında olasılıkların ufkunu genişletmeye devam ediyor.

definition: the action or process of formally consulting or discussing
example_sentence: The policy changes require extensive consultation with faculty, students, and administrators.
turkish_translation: Politika değişiklikleri öğretim üyeleri, öğrenciler ve yöneticilerle kapsamlı istişare gerektiriyor.

definition: a person exercising government or dominion; a straight strip used for measuring
example_sentence: The geometry student used a ruler to draw precise measurements for the architectural diagram.
turkish_translation: Geometri öğrencisi mimari diyagram için hassas ölçümler çizmek için cetvel kullandı.

definition: without restriction or impediment; willingly and readily
example_sentence: In the seminar, students were encouraged to express their opinions freely without fear of judgment.
turkish_translation: Seminerde öğrenciler yargılanma korkusu olmadan fikirlerini özgürce ifade etmeye teşvik edildi.

definition: to move or cause to move in a circle around an axis or center
example_sentence: The research team decided to rotate leadership responsibilities among senior members.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibi liderlik sorumluluklarını kıdemli üyeler arasında değiştirmeye karar verdi.

definition: a raw material or primary agricultural product that can be bought and sold
example_sentence: The economics professor explained how education is increasingly viewed as a commodity in market-driven societies.
turkish_translation: Ekonomi profesörü eğitimin piyasa güdümlü toplumlarda giderek bir meta olarak görüldüğünü açıkladı.

definition: height above a given level, especially sea level; the action of elevating someone or something
example_sentence: The mountain research station operates at an elevation of 3,000 meters above sea level.
turkish_translation: Dağ araştırma istasyonu deniz seviyesinden 3.000 metre yükseklikte faaliyet gösteriyor.

definition: very great or intense; showing great knowledge or understanding
example_sentence: The research findings had a profound impact on our understanding of cognitive development.
turkish_translation: Araştırma bulguları bilişsel gelişim anlayışımız üzerinde derin bir etkiye sahipti.

definition: to come between so as to prevent or alter a result or course of events
example_sentence: The university decided to intervene when student performance began declining significantly.
turkish_translation: Üniversite öğrenci performansı önemli ölçüde düşmeye başladığında müdahale etmeye karar verdi.

definition: to give something, typically money, in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury
example_sentence: Higher salaries help compensate teachers for the demanding nature of their profession.
turkish_translation: Yüksek maaşlar öğretmenlere mesleklerinin zorlu doğası için tazminat sağlamaya yardımcı olur.

definition: relating to an atom or atoms
example_sentence: The physics course covers atomic structure and molecular interactions in detail.
turkish_translation: Fizik dersi atomik yapı ve moleküler etkileşimleri ayrıntılı olarak kapsar.

definition: of little worth or importance
example_sentence: What seems trivial to experts may be fundamental knowledge for beginning students.
turkish_translation: Uzmanlara önemsiz görünen şey başlangıç seviyesindeki öğrenciler için temel bilgi olabilir.

definition: the attitude of a person or organization toward something; a particular way of standing
example_sentence: The university took a firm stance against academic dishonesty and plagiarism.
turkish_translation: Üniversite akademik sahtekarlık ve intihal konusunda sert bir tavır aldı.

definition: to make or become stable
example_sentence: New policies aim to stabilize enrollment numbers in graduate programs.
turkish_translation: Yeni politikalar lisansüstü programlarda kayıt sayılarını stabilize etmeyi amaçlıyor.

definition: by which; according to which
example_sentence: The university implemented a new system whereby students can access resources online.
turkish_translation: Üniversite öğrencilerin kaynaklara çevrimiçi erişebileceği yeni bir sistem uyguladı.

definition: a person, typically one more remote than a grandparent, from whom one is descended
example_sentence: Anthropologists study how ancient ancestors adapted to changing environmental conditions.
turkish_translation: Antropologlar antik ataların değişen çevresel koşullara nasıl uyum sağladığını inceler.

definition: the study of heredity and the variation of inherited characteristics
example_sentence: Advances in genetics have revolutionized personalized medicine and treatment approaches.
turkish_translation: Genetikteki ilerlemeler kişiselleştirilmiş tıp ve tedavi yaklaşımlarını devrimleştirdi.

definition: a stable subatomic particle occurring in all atomic nuclei, with a positive electric charge
example_sentence: The physics student calculated the number of protons in the carbon nucleus.
turkish_translation: Fizik öğrencisi karbon çekirdeğindeki proton sayısını hesapladı.

definition: a salt of phosphoric acid containing the anion PO₄³� or one of its condensed forms
example_sentence: The biology lab analyzed phosphate levels in water samples from the local lake.
turkish_translation: Biyoloji laboratuvarı yerel gölden alınan su örneklerindeki fosfat seviyelerini analiz etti.

definition: the force that attracts a body toward the center of the earth
example_sentence: Einstein’s theory revolutionized our understanding of gravity and spacetime.
turkish_translation: Einstein’ın teorisi yerçekimi ve uzay-zaman anlayışımızı devrimleştirdi.

definition: either of the two points of a magnet, electric cell, etc., that have opposite qualities
example_sentence: The experiment demonstrated how opposite poles of magnets attract each other.
turkish_translation: Deney mıknatısların zıt kutuplarının birbirini nasıl çektiğini gösterdi.

definition: a game, toy, or problem designed to test ingenuity or knowledge
example_sentence: The research findings presented a puzzle that challenged existing theories.
turkish_translation: Araştırma bulguları mevcut teorilere meydan okuyan bir bulmaca sundu.

definition: relating to or affecting respiration or the organs of respiration
example_sentence: The medical study focused on respiratory diseases in urban environments.
turkish_translation: Tıbbi çalışma kentsel ortamlardaki solunum hastalıklarına odaklandı.

definition: the complete removal or destruction of something
example_sentence: The elimination of errors is crucial for accurate scientific data analysis.
turkish_translation: Hataların ortadan kaldırılması doğru bilimsel veri analizi için çok önemlidir.

definition: a way out, especially of a public building, room, or passenger vehicle
example_sentence: The laboratory had multiple exit routes for emergency evacuation procedures.
turkish_translation: Laboratuvarın acil tahliye prosedürleri için birden fazla çıkış yolu vardı.

definition: dishonest or fraudulent conduct by those in power
example_sentence: The sociology research examined the relationship between corruption and economic development.
turkish_translation: Sosyoloji araştırması yolsuzluk ve ekonomik kalkınma arasındaki ilişkiyi inceledi.

definition: to move continuously or freely through a closed system or area
example_sentence: Ideas circulate rapidly in academic communities through conferences and publications.
turkish_translation: Fikirler konferanslar ve yayınlar aracılığıyla akademik topluluklarda hızla dolaşır.

definition: not discovered or known about; uncertain
example_sentence: The researcher studied obscure manuscripts to uncover historical linguistic patterns.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacı tarihsel dilbilimsel kalıpları ortaya çıkarmak için belirsiz el yazmalarını inceledi.

definition: to deny the truth of a statement by asserting the opposite
example_sentence: The experimental results contradict the widely accepted theoretical predictions.
turkish_translation: Deneysel sonuçlar yaygın olarak kabul edilen teorik tahminlerle çelişiyor.

definition: to prevent something from continuing or being carried out properly
example_sentence: External noise can interfere with students’ concentration during examinations.
turkish_translation: Dış gürültü sınavlar sırasında öğrencilerin konsantrasyonunu bozabilir.

definition: a deeply distressing or disturbing experience
example_sentence: Psychologists study how childhood trauma affects long-term cognitive development.
turkish_translation: Psikologlar çocukluk travmasının uzun vadeli bilişsel gelişimi nasıl etkilediğini inceler.

definition: moving, pointing, or leading to a higher place or position
example_sentence: The university shows an upward trend in research funding and publication rates.
turkish_translation: Üniversite araştırma finansmanı ve yayın oranlarında yukarı yönlü bir eğilim gösteriyor.

definition: unattractively large or bloated; total before deductions
example_sentence: The study revealed gross inequalities in educational resource distribution.
turkish_translation: Çalışma eğitim kaynağı dağılımında büyük eşitsizlikleri ortaya koydu.

definition: relating to sight, especially in relation to the action of light
example_sentence: The laboratory uses advanced optical instruments to examine microscopic specimens.
turkish_translation: Laboratuvar mikroskobik örnekleri incelemek için gelişmiş optik aletler kullanıyor.

definition: relating to a political theory derived from Karl Marx
example_sentence: The political science course examines communist ideology and its historical implementations.
turkish_translation: Siyaset bilimi dersi komünist ideoloji ve tarihsel uygulamalarını inceler.

definition: any of the world’s main continuous expanses of land
example_sentence: Migration patterns between continents have shaped human genetic diversity.
turkish_translation: Kıtalar arası göç kalıpları insan genetik çeşitliliğini şekillendirmiştir.

definition: the branch of science concerned with the nature and properties of matter and energy
example_sentence: Modern physics has revolutionized our understanding of time, space, and matter.
turkish_translation: Modern fizik zaman, uzay ve madde anlayışımızı devrimleştirdi.

definition: capable of working successfully; feasible
example_sentence: The research team proposed a viable solution to the complex environmental problem.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibi karmaşık çevre sorununa uygulanabilir bir çözüm önerdi.

definition: an arm or leg of a person or four-legged animal, or a bird’s wing
example_sentence: The prosthetic limb technology has advanced significantly in recent years.
turkish_translation: Protez uzuv teknolojisi son yıllarda önemli ölçüde ilerledi.

definition: to get or bring something back from somewhere
example_sentence: Students can retrieve their research papers from the online database system.
